title: Social Media & Content Specialist
description:
Linton Co is a franchise-based hospitality company with a portfolio of brands rooted in outdoor hospitality and wellness. We're looking for a Social Media & Content Coordinator who lives at the intersection of design and social: someone who can take a library of photo and video assets and turn it into scroll-stopping organic content and high-performing ads across TikTok, Instagram,
, and YouTube. You'll execute strategy set by marketing leadership, bring your own ideas to the table, and report back on what's working so every round of content gets sharper.



What You'll Do

Organic social content

Design and edit organic content for TikTok, Instagram,
, and YouTube 

Adapt content to each platform's formats, trends, and best practices rather than reposting one asset everywhere

Write engaging, on-brand English captions and organic social copy



Paid social creative

Design ad creative  for Meta, TikTok, and YouTube ads

Write English ad copy, including hooks, headlines, primary text, and CTAs

Produce creative variations for testing and iterate based on results



Ideation and concepting

Pitch new content concepts, series, formats, and campaign ideas

Stay on top of social trends, audio, and formats, and translate what's relevant to our brands

Help bring brand campaigns and seasonal initiatives to life on social



Performance insights

Track the performance of the content you create, both organic and paid

Use organic and trial-reel performance to recommend which content should become paid creative, then adapt the winners into ad variations and formats (reel to carousel to static).

Share regular insights on what's resonating and why, with recommendations for what to try next

Use those learnings to inform future creative





Brand stewardship

Apply brand guidelines consistently across all Linton Co brands

Help keep the photo and video asset library organized and easy to work from



Workflow efficiency

Find and adopt AI and agentic tools that speed up production, scale creative variations, and streamline organization and reporting

Keep design and copywriting human-driven, using AI to support the process, not to create the final work

What You'll Bring

2+ years of experience creating social content, agency or in-house

A portfolio showing both organic social and paid ad creative

Strong design and short-form video editing skills (Adobe Creative Cloud, Canva, CapCut, or similar)

Hands-on experience with TikTok, Instagram,
, and YouTube, and a clear understanding of how content differs across each

Strong English copywriting for both organic social and ads

Comfort reading platform analytics and turning numbers into practical takeaways

A great aesthetic and visual eye, with an instinct for what makes content feel premium, warm, and authentic

Genuine enthusiasm for outdoor hospitality, travel, and wellness

Ability to work from a brief, deliver near-final work on the first pass, and confidently share ideas during brainstorming. 

Organized and comfortable managing multiple brands and deadlines at once

Embrace of AI and agentic workflows to work faster, increase output, and stay organized

Creative and copy remain human-led; we're looking for someone who uses AI to multiply their impact, not replace their craft

Nice to Have

Experience creating content for LinkedIn

Familiarity with Meta Ads Manager and TikTok Ads Manager

Experience in hospitality, travel, or lifestyle brands

Experience with motion graphics or animation



How to Apply



Please send your updated resume and portfolio to 
 portfolio should include examples of relevant work such as website copy, social media content,
 campaigns, brand guidelines, marketing communications, content calendars, creative projects, copywriting, or other work that demonstrates your ability to manage brand and communications responsibilities.



 Subject Line: LINTON SOCIAL MEDIA & CONTENT SPECIALIST



Please make sure your portfolio clearly shows your actual involvement in the projects you submit.



Applications without an updated resume and portfolio may not be considered.



We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Marketing Operations Specialist
description:
About Linton Co



Linton Co is looking for a highly organized, technical, and data-driven Marketing Operations Specialist to join our growing marketing team.



This role is responsible for the technical backbone of our marketing engine. You will manage marketing technology, build landing pages and forms, create funnels and automated follow-up sequences, implement tracking and analytics, and use performance data to identify opportunities for improvement.



This is an execution-focused role. You will take an established marketing strategy and be responsible for building it accurately, ensuring everything is properly tracked, and continuously improving the systems based on performance data.



You should be someone who enjoys working inside marketing platforms, troubleshooting systems, analyzing data, and making sure the details behind a campaign are working correctly from the first click through to the final conversion.



What You Will Do

Marketing Technology & Systems



You will serve as an internal resource for our marketing technology stack, particularly GoHighLevel for B2B marketing and Klaviyo for B2C marketing.



You will maintain contact databases, lists, integrations, deliverability, and overall platform organization. You will also identify opportunities to improve our existing technology stack and recommend new tools or solutions when they can improve efficiency, tracking, automation, or campaign performance.



Funnels, Landing Pages & Automation



You will build and maintain landing pages, forms, and multi-step marketing funnels for lead generation and campaigns.



You will connect landing pages and forms to the appropriate funnels and build automated
 and SMS sequences based on funnel stages, lead behavior, and other relevant triggers.



You will make sure leads move through the funnel correctly and receive the appropriate messaging at each stage.



You will troubleshoot issues such as leads not receiving follow-up messages, incorrect tagging, broken integrations, missing data, or other funnel-related problems.



You will also work closely with the sales team to understand lead quality and lead value and use that information to improve funnel logic, automation, and lead scoring.



Tracking, Analytics & Reporting



You will manage tracking and tagging across platforms including GA4, Google Ads, Meta Ads, Google Tag Manager, and other relevant marketing platforms.



You will ensure conversion events, pixels, UTMs, and other tracking mechanisms are properly implemented and consistently maintained across campaigns.



You will build and maintain reporting dashboards that clearly show marketing and funnel performance.



You will create data visualizations that make it easy to understand where leads originated, how they are progressing through the pipeline, and whether those leads ultimately generated revenue.



You will work with the sales team to connect closed revenue back to the original campaign, lead source, and marketing activity whenever possible.



You will regularly audit tracking and reporting systems to identify data gaps, inconsistencies, or discrepancies and take ownership of correcting them.



You will also document funnel logic, automation workflows, tracking configurations, and recurring processes through clear SOPs so that our systems are organized and scalable.



Optimization & Testing



You will analyze marketing and funnel performance to identify friction points, drop-off areas, conversion opportunities, and other areas where performance can be improved.



You will propose and execute A/B tests involving landing pages,
s, SMS campaigns, subject lines, funnel steps, messaging, and other campaign elements.



You will monitor test results, document findings, and make data-driven recommendations for future improvements.



What We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone with at least 2 years of experience in marketing operations, marketing automation, CRM management, funnel management, or a similar role.



You should have hands-on experience with GoHighLevel and/or Klaviyo, or comparable platforms such as HubSpot, ActiveCampaign, or Marketo.



You should have practical experience building landing pages, forms, automated workflows, and multi-step marketing funnels.



You should have a working knowledge of Google Tag Manager, GA4, Google Ads, Meta Ads, conversion tracking, pixels, and UTM tracking.



You should be comfortable working with campaign data and turning that information into specific, actionable recommendations.



Experience building dashboards and data visualizations using tools such as Looker Studio, Google Sheets, Tableau, or similar platforms is important.



You should be comfortable using AI tools to assist with building systems, analyzing data, creating reports, troubleshooting, and improving campaign performance.



Experience designing and running A/B tests is highly valuable.



Most importantly, you need to have strong attention to detail. This position is responsible for maintaining the accuracy of the marketing data and systems that the company relies on to make business decisions.



Nice to Have



Experience working with both B2B and B2C marketing campaigns is a plus.



Advanced Google Tag Manager experience, including server-side tracking, is a plus.



Basic knowledge of HTML and CSS for landing page customization is helpful.



Experience with SMS marketing and TCPA compliance is also a plus.



Who Will Succeed in This Role



The ideal candidate is technical, organized, analytical, and highly detail-oriented. You don't need to be the person creating the overall marketing strategy, but you need to be able to take a strategy and execute the technical components accurately.



You should enjoy solving problems, investigating why something is not working, working across multiple marketing platforms, and finding ways to make systems more efficient.



You should be comfortable taking ownership of projects and following through without needing constant supervision.



If you are someone who can build the system, verify that it is working, measure the results, identify what needs to improve, and implement those improvements, we would like to hear from you.



How to Apply



Please send your updated resume and portfolio to 
 portfolio should include examples of relevant marketing operations work, such as funnels, landing pages, automation workflows, dashboards, tracking implementations, campaign systems, or other projects that demonstrate your technical and analytical capabilities.



 Subject Line: LINTON MARKETING



Applications without an updated resume and portfolio may not be considered.



Please make sure your portfolio clearly shows your actual involvement in the projects you submit. We are particularly interested in seeing examples of systems you have built, marketing automation you have managed, tracking implementations, dashboards, funnel optimization, and measurable improvements you have contributed to.



We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Land Acquisition Rep
description:
Land Acquisition Virtual Assistant (Full-Time, US Hours)



We're a US-based land investing company. We buy vacant land directly from property owners. We're hiring one sharp, reliable VA to talk to sellers, analyze deals, and negotiate offers.



This is not a copy-paste data entry role. You'll be on the phone with real sellers, running numbers, and making offers on real properties. If you do this well, you become one of the most important people in the business.



What You'll Do

Call and follow up with land sellers (inbound and outbound)



Analyze properties: comps, pricing, access, zoning, red flags



Negotiate purchase price directly with sellers and lock in agreements



Keep the CRM clean, updated, and organized daily



Send end-of-day reports on calls, offers, and pipeline



Requirements

Full-time, US business hours (EST). Non-negotiable.



Located in a major city with fast, stable internet. Backup internet and power required. "My connection dropped" is not an acceptable pattern.



Excellent spoken and written English. You'll be talking to American property owners every day — clear, neutral, confident on the phone.



Highly reliable. You show up on time, every day, and answer messages fast.



Extremely organized. Nothing falls through the cracks. You follow up when you say you will.

Quiet workspace, working headset, and a computer that can handle a dialer + CRM



Nice to Have

Experience with GoHighLevel (GHL) — big plus



Prior real estate, land, cold calling, sales, or acquisitions experience



Comfort reading maps, county GIS sites, and parcel data

Long-term, stable full-time position

title: Maintenance Engineer
description:
We are seeking a proactive, highly organized, and detail-oriented Maintenance Engineer to oversee daily property service requests, vendor dispatch, and operational logistics. In this fully remote position, you will be responsible for receiving incoming maintenance requests, virtually assessing the situation, scheduling appropriate local vendors, and following up to ensure timely resolution.

We are looking for strong problem-solving skills, excellent communication, vendor management abilities, and high operational efficiency to manage property service workflows remotely.



Key Responsibilities:



Request & Logistics Management

• Request Handling: Receive, log, and prioritize daily tenant/occupant repair requests, service inquiries, and support tickets.

• Virtual Problem Diagnosis: Communicate with occupants to gather clear details, photos, or videos to understand the issue and identify the right service provider needed.

• Vendor Dispatch & Scheduling: Contact, schedule, and assign appropriate third-party vendors or local technicians to resolve issues, coordinating access with property occupants.

• Inspection Logistics: Coordinate schedules and log appointments for property inspections between occupants, local team members, and third-party inspectors (you will schedule and track logistics, not conduct physical walk-throughs).

• Emergency Escalation: Serve as the primary remote point of contact for urgent property issues, quickly dispatching local emergency contractors to minimize damage or risk.

Vendor & Contractor Management

• Vendor Sourcing & Coordination: Identify, reach out to, schedule, and follow up with external contractors and service providers (e.g., plumbers, electricians, HVAC specialists, locksmiths, pest control).

• Service Follow-up & Quality Assurance: Review vendor job reports, completion notes, and photos remotely to verify that requested work was completed satisfactorily before closing tickets.

• Cost & Invoice Review: Request quotes, review pricing for reasonableness, track service costs, and verify vendor invoices against completed work order details.

• Vendor Relationship Building: Maintain an organized database of reliable local service providers, contractors, and suppliers.



Qualifications & Requirements:



• Experience: 2–4 years of experience in Operations, Engineering, Logistics, Customer Service, Dispatch, or Administrative Project Management.

• Vendor Management: Proven ability to source, communicate with, schedule, and manage external vendors or service providers remotely.

• Problem-Solving Skills: Strong diagnostic capabilities and logical reasoning to ask the right questions, troubleshoot issues remotely, and determine practical solutions.

• Communication: Excellent written and verbal English skills to interact professionally with occupants, property managers, and external contractors.

• Organizational Skills: Exceptional capacity to multi-task, prioritize high-urgency requests, track status across multiple open work orders, and maintain clean digital logs.

• Tech-Savvy: Comfortable learning and using cloud-based software, ticketing platforms, communication tools, and work order management systems.



WARNINGS:

* NO TEMPORARY workers.

* The working schedule is from Monday to Friday, from 8:30 am until 5:00 pm EST.

* NO working for another company at the same time.

* NO hiring subs to do what we hired you to do.

* We terminate immediately due to these violations.



Citiside Properties is a property management company that manages properties for investors with portfolios of homes and/or multi-unit apartments needing off-site management.



Core Values we expect team members to remember:

*Trust

*Transparency 

* Go getter.

title: AI Video Creator & Editor / Web Designer (Full-Time, Remote)
description:
I'm Kenji, a business owner based in Germany. I'm looking for a full-time, remote AI Video Creator and Video Editor / Web Designer to help with two areas:



1. Marketing for a German e-commerce brand in the computer accessory space. This is mainly AI-generated product videos for Amazon and short-form social media content.

2. My web agency, where we build Wordpress websites for German clients using AI Tools like Claude Code/Codex.



Depending on what you're better at, you will do more of one or the other, and we will figure out the split together. Beginners are welcome if you have a good eye for design, are motivated, and if you are fast at learning new things. I will train you.



Video tasks:

- Create and edit AI product videos for Amazon and social media, including short-form content for TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts

- Generate clips with AI video tools, add music etc.

- Edit videos

- Try out new AI tools and models



Web design tasks:

- Design and build websites for clients using AI

- Update and improve existing client websites



Requirements:

- Good eye for design and attention to detail

- Creative eye for pacing, visual storytelling and clean composition

- Interest in AI tools and prompting for video and image generation. Experience is a plus but not required

- Familiar with short-form video formats for TikTok, Reels and YouTube Shorts

- Able to think from the customer's point of view

- Good written English

- Stable internet connection

- Laptop or PC that can handle video editing



Nice to have:

- German language skills or understanding of German culture

- Experience with video editing

- Experience with web design

- Experience with local SEO is a plus

- Experience with AI video tools like Higgsfield, Kling, Seedance, Runway, Veo etc.

- Experience with AI Coding Agents like Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity

- Experience making product videos or ads for e-commerce brands

- Motion graphics or animation

- Experience with UGC-style videos or paid social ads

- Understanding of ad performance numbers and how to improve videos based on them



Schedule:

- 45 hours per week, Monday to Saturday

- At least 5 hours overlap with German business hours



Salary:

- Php 28,000 per month



What I offer:

- Long-term full-time position

- You work directly with me, no middle managers

- Flexible hours, as long as you have the 5 hours overlap with Germany

- work with latest AI agent tools

- Your work is seen by real customers on Amazon and on client websites



How to apply:

Please add the word "Agentic Engineering" in the subject of your application so I know you read the full post. Answer in this order:



1. About You

Name, age, location, current work situation, your CV.



2. Your Work

2–3 samples of your work (videos, designs, websites). If you're a beginner, anything that shows your eye is fine too, like tattoos you designed, photos, drawings or your own YouTube or TikTok channel. For each one, tell me what you did yourself and which tools you used.



3. Your Setup

Which AI tools, editing or design software you have used, details about your PC / Laptop and internet reliability and speed.



4. Mini Task (about 30–45 min)

There is no perfect answer, I want to see how you think and what you notice.



VIDEO TASK



The situation:

Imagine this is a new client project. The client is a brand that sells this vertical mouse on Amazon:



The listing has no product video yet, and they want one.



What you need to know:

- The video is shown on the Amazon product page. 30–45 seconds, 16:9

- The client gives us a 3D model of the mouse, so we can render clean product shots from any angle, with any camera movement

- Shots with real hands on a real desk can be filmed by us, or generated with AI video tools (Higgsfield, Kling, Seedance)

- You can use product facts that are in the listing, if you want to show something that isn't there, write it down as a question for the client



Your task:

Make a storyboard for this video:

- One picture per shot. A photo of a quick drawing on paper you take a photo of is fine too, or images you made with an AI tool

- Imagine you are the creative director. Explain to me each scene, how the camera moves, the text on screen, what I can see as the customer watching the video.

- Any insights you were able to gather from the Amazon reviews that you feel like should be shown also in the video? Mention what

- Share the storyboard as a link, pdf, image etc.

The video can have a different style compared to the listing images if you have a better design vision, or could be same, the client is okay with either option.



WEB DESIGN TASK



The situation:

Imagine this new client: a roofing company (Dachdeckerei) in Munich, newly founded a month ago. The two founders are roofers who worked for a larger roofing company for over 10 years before starting their own business. One of them is a master roofer (Dachdeckermeister). They are a team of 4 and work in Munich and up to 30 km around it.



Their services: roof repairs, storm damage, roof renovation, flat roofs and gutters.

Their customers: mostly homeowners aged 40–70 who call when something is leaking, and property management companies (Hausverwaltungen) with apartment buildings.



They don't have a website yet, only a Google Business Profile with 6 reviews (all 5 stars). They have a logo, photos from their first jobs (taken with a phone), a phone number, WhatsApp and an
 address.



What they want: more inquiries, and to look like a solid, established business.



They send us this website as inspiration:



"I like this website. It looks honest and you can find the phone number right away. I'd like something similar."



Our first step: we take this website as the template for our client.



Your task (no need to design anything, just explain in words):

1. Go through the website from top to bottom. For each part, tell me if you would keep it, change it or remove it for our client, and why. If you change it, what exactly would you change?

2. What does our client need that the template doesn't have?

3. Any hidden assumptions or unclear points you want to challenge or clarify with the client first?



Please write it in your own words.

title: Learning & Development Specialist
description:
Role Summary



PawPay is a growing company focused on delivering innovative financial solutions for the veterinary industry. As our team continues to expand, we are looking for a creative, organized, and proactive Learning & Development (L&D) Specialist who can take ownership of our employee training programs, learning materials, and professional development initiatives. We are looking for someone who is not only an experienced trainer but also a strong content creator, researcher, and LMS administrator who can independently develop engaging learning experiences.







Key Responsibilities



Training Material Development & Content Creation

Learning Management System (LMS) Administration

Training Facilitation & Employee Development

Research & Learning Program Improvement

Training Administration & Coordination

Others to follow



Qualifications



At least 2 years of professional experience as a Trainer, Training Specialist, Learning & Development Specialist, or similar role.

Hands-on experience creating training materials is mandatory, including presentations, instructional guides, e-learning modules, and assessments.

Practical experience using and administering a Learning Management System (LMS) is mandatory. Experience with TalentLMS, Moodle, Docebo, or similar platforms is acceptable.

Proven experience facilitating training sessions, preferably in a remote or virtual work environment.

Strong research skills, with the ability to independently gather, validate, and organize information into effective learning materials.

A creative eye for visual design, presentation layout, and engaging educational content.

Familiarity with training administration, including scheduling, attendance tracking, progress monitoring, reporting, and documentation.

Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities.

Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Google Slides, Canva, Google Workspace, and other content creation tools.

Ability to work independently, proactively communicate updates, and collaborate with cross-functional teams.

Must be available to conduct training, onboarding, and coordination meetings during assigned PST working hours.





Preferred Candidate



We’re looking for someone who is:



Experience in BPO, SaaS, fintech, insurance, customer service, or other fast-paced industries.

Experience developing structured onboarding programs and employee certification pathways.

Familiarity with instructional design principles, such as ADDIE, Bloom's Taxonomy, or adult learning methodologies.

Experience using AI-powered content creation and research tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gamma, or similar platforms.

Basic video editing, graphic design, or interactive course creation experience.

Experience conducting training needs analysis (TNA) and measuring training effectiveness.

Experience supporting leadership development, compliance training, and employee engagement initiatives.

What we're looking for: 



We are looking for someone who can take ownership of the L&D function rather than simply facilitate training sessions.



Our ideal candidate is:



Creative: Can transform ordinary training content into engaging and visually appealing learning experiences.

Resourceful: Comfortable researching unfamiliar topics and independently developing learning materials.

Organized: Can manage training calendars, LMS assignments, attendance, deadlines, and reports without constant supervision.

Proactive: Regularly provides updates, identifies potential issues early, and follows through on commitments.

Confident Trainer: Comfortable conducting live virtual sessions and engaging employees with different experience levels.

Tech-Savvy: Familiar with digital learning platforms, collaboration tools, and AI-assisted content creation.

Dependable: Available during agreed working hours and responsive to training requests and team coordination.



If you’re someone who thrives in a results-oriented, entrepreneurial environment and wants to grow quickly, this is the right place for you.

title: Operations Manager / Client Success Manager (GoHighLevel + Automations)
description:
Plumbify helps residential plumbing companies generate qualified inbound calls and booked jobs through Google Ads, Local Services Ads, and Meta advertising.



We are growing fast and looking for a sharp, reliable operator who can own client onboarding, communication, systems, and delivery.



This is not a basic assistant role. We are not looking for someone who waits for instructions, disappears during work hours, or escalates every problem. We hold ourselves to a very high standard, and we will hold you to that same standard.



SCHEDULE

You must work U.S. business hours: 11:00 AM to 7:00 PM Eastern (8:00 AM to 4:00 PM Pacific). You will talk with clients across U.S. time zones.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN

- Getting new clients launched quickly and correctly

- Managing onboarding from signed agreement through launch

- Chasing clients for missing information, access, assets, and approvals

- Handling client calls clearly and professionally

- Keeping every client, task, deadline, and deliverable organized

- Building and troubleshooting GoHighLevel workflows, domains, number pools, pipelines, and automations

- Managing integrations through Zapier, Make, webhooks, and call tracking tools

- QAing your own work before it reaches the client

- Solving problems on your own instead of escalating them

- Spotting risks before they become client fires

- Improving SOPs and helping build AI-assisted systems

- Coordinating with our ads team so launches happen smoothly



WHAT YOU WILL NOT DO

You will not run ads or campaign strategy. We have a dedicated ads team for that. Your job is client communication, internal coordination, follow-up, and solving operational issues to keep delivery moving.



Example: if a client hasn't provided what we need to launch, you will explain exactly what's missing, set a deadline, follow up until it's done, keep the client informed, and only escalate with a diagnosis and a recommended fix.



REQUIREMENTS

- Excellent spoken and written English with a clear accent. You will be on the phone with U.S. business owners

- Comfortable leading calls

- Strong GoHighLevel experience

- Experience with Zapier, Make, webhooks, automations, or call tracking

- Strong attention to detail

- Reliable availability during U.S. hours

- Can manage multiple clients without constant supervision

- Stable internet, backup power, and a quiet work environment



YOU ARE NOT A FIT IF

- You disappear during working hours

- You need the same task explained repeatedly

- You repeat mistakes without fixing the cause

- You escalate every problem without trying to solve it first

- You avoid client calls

- You don't want to be measured by results



COMPENSATION

$800 to $1,500/month base depending on experience, technical ability, communication, and ownership. We pay based on what you can prove you can own.



HOW TO APPLY

Applications without a Loom video will not be considered.



Send:

1. Your resume or OnlineJobs.ph profile

2. A 2 to 3 minute Loom video answering:

   - Why are you a strong fit for this role?

   - How would you handle a client who hasn't provided what's needed to launch?

   - How would you handle an angry client whose launch is delayed?

   - Tell us about a technical problem you solved on your own.

   - What would success look like after 90 days?

3. Your GoHighLevel and automation experience

4. The U.S. hours you're available



Shortlisted candidates will do a paid technical and client-communication test.



If you're sharp, proactive, reliable, technically strong, and great with clients, apply.

description:
*KINDLY READ THE JOB DESCRIPTION & THE APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS CAREFULLY.*



The Nabo Group is hiring Assistant Community Association Manager for our growing team, who enjoys solving problems, responsible, organized, detail oriented, and reliable to join our fun/hard working team. You must have excellent communication skills.



Key Responsibilities:

Customer Service and Issue Resolution:

- Respond to routine customer service requests promptly and appropriately.

- Address issues such as missed trash pickups or utility concerns, providing updates and progress reports to the Manager.

- Troubleshoot common problems and help facilitate resolutions.



Interdepartmental and Vendor Communication:

- Collaborate with internal departments, including accounting and maintenance, to ensure smooth coordination of services and accurate information sharing.

- Communicate effectively with external vendors regarding routine tasks, project updates, and general coordination.

- Serve as a point of contact between stakeholders to help streamline operations and resolve issues efficiently.



Portfolio Reporting:

- Prepare and send weekly and monthly reports on the status of the property portfolio to the Manager.

- Track and manage access information, including physical keys and access codes, and coordinate with internal teams, external vendors, and homeowners to ensure proper access to units as needed.



Communication and Notifications:

- Provide the Manager with the necessary information to send notices to homeowners regarding updates or community issues.

- Serve as a backup for phone calls, handling inquiries and directing them to the appropriate person as needed.



Financial Support and Oversight:

- Assist with accounts payable by reviewing and submitting invoices for approval.

- Maintain general understanding of general ledger management, ensuring expenses are properly tracked and categorized.

- Support budgeting processes by gathering relevant financial information and monitoring expenses.

- Communicate with the Manager regarding any financial discrepancies or questions related to invoices or expenses.



On-Call Participation:

- Participate in the on-call rotation one week per month to handle any urgent issues that arise outside of regular business hours.



Qualifications:

- Time Management: Ability to prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, and manage multiple projects simultaneously with minimal supervision.

- Organizational Skills: Strong organizational skills, with an emphasis on keeping detailed records and maintaining accurate documentation.

- Communication: Excellent verbal and written English communication skills, with the ability to interact professionally with homeowners, team members, and vendors.

- Problem-Solving: Proactive in identifying issues and finding solutions to ensure that service requests and community concerns are addressed efficiently.

- Financial Acumen: General knowledge of accounts payable, invoice approval processes, general ledger tracking, and basic budgeting principles.

- Collaboration: Ability to work effectively across departments and with outside vendors to support HOA operations.

- Working Hours: Must be amenable to work in any US time zones



Working conditions:

This is a fully remote position. Applicants must meet certain requirements for a working computer and consent to our IT department conducting an analysis of the computer for cybersecurity and safety purposes.



Expected Work Times:

Candidates are generally expected to work during U.S. Eastern Standard Time (EST) business hours. The TM must be available during working hours for meetings and accessible by phone/text during the workday.



Time Tracking:

Use of Hubstaff time-tracking software is required while performing work.



This is a full-time contract position. Payments are made via Wise on the 15th and 30th of each month. While this is a contractor role, we do offer a variety of perks for our contractors.

- Please send a link to your video recording introducing yourself & your relevant experience based on the job description.



Kindly send your application to

Shortlisted applicants will be contacted by
 for interview scheduling.

Looking forward to working with you!

title: Finance & Business Support Officer - Sage 50 Expert
description:
Full-Time Remote Finance & Business Support Officer

UK Hours | Monday–Friday | Long-Term Role



We are a UK-based care organisation looking for an experienced accountant to take responsibility for our bookkeeping, monthly management accounts and a range of administrative duties.



This is a hands-on role requiring strong UK accounting experience and advanced practical knowledge of Sage 50 Accounts. You must be comfortable working independently, meeting deadlines and supporting senior management.



Main responsibilities:



ACCOUNTING AND FINANCE

Complete day-to-day bookkeeping and maintain accurate accounting records

Prepare monthly management accounts and financial reports

Process sales invoices, purchase invoices, payments and expenses

Carry out bank, supplier and balance-sheet reconciliations

Maintain nominal ledgers and ensure transactions are correctly coded

Support VAT returns, budgeting, cash-flow monitoring and year-end processes

Maintain accurate Excel trackers and financial records

Use Sage 50 Accounts extensively as part of your daily work



ADMINISTRATION

Manage calendars, meetings, appointments and training arrangements

Order supplies for care homes and monitor value for money

Maintain procurement, finance and operational trackers

Prepare and professionally format letters, reports and other documents

Coordinate training venues, attendance and travel arrangements

Provide general administrative support to the leadership team

Help staff resolve straightforward software and IT issues

Use Microsoft Teams, Excel, Word and AI tools such as ChatGPT effectively



Essential requirements:

At least 3 years’ experience working with UK companies

Strong bookkeeping and monthly management accounts experience

In-depth, hands-on knowledge of Sage 50 Accounts

Good understanding of UK accounting, VAT and business administration

Advanced Excel and Microsoft Office skills

Excellent written and spoken English

Strong attention to detail and ability to meet deadlines

Proactive, dependable and able to solve problems independently

Comfortable handling both accounting and administrative duties

Reliable internet connection and a quiet professional workspace

Experience working with a UK care organisation or another regulated business would be an advantage.



Working hours:

Monday to Friday, 9:00am–5:00pm UK time, 40 hours per week.

Applicants must be consistently available during UK working hours.



How to apply:

Please message us through OnlineJobs.ph and include:



A brief summary of your UK accounting experience

How many years you have used Sage 50 and which functions you use regularly

Your experience preparing monthly management accounts

Your administrative or executive-support experience

Your expected monthly salary

Your earliest available start date



Please attach your CV.



To confirm that you have read the full advert, begin your message with:

“I have UK accounting and Sage 50 experience.”

title: Executive Assistant (with Quickbooks experience)
description:
Executive Assistant with Bookkeeping (Full-Time, Remote)



Hours: Full-Time | 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM EST



About the Role

We are a dynamic and fast-growing company looking for an Executive Assistant with real bookkeeping experience to support our leadership team.



The bookkeeping side is the core of this role. You will own QuickBooks: categorizing expenses correctly against the chart of accounts, preparing monthly client invoices, and keeping the books clean and current. Alongside that, you will handle vendor follow-ups, calendars, travel, and general admin.



Please note: this role requires hands-on QuickBooks or equivalent bookkeeping experience. If you have not personally categorized expenses or prepared invoices in an accounting system before, this will not be the right fit.



We are looking for someone who takes ownership, comes to the team with answers rather than waiting to be asked, and flags questions early instead of guessing.



What You’ll Do

Bookkeeping and Invoicing

Categorize expenses in QuickBooks against the chart of accounts and attribute them to the correct project

Prepare monthly client invoices and bring them to the team ready for review

Keep receipts, records, and documentation uploaded and organized

Track which invoices are paid and which are outstanding, and follow up on overdue accounts

Ask when something is unclear rather than filing it incorrectly



Vendor Coordination

Reach out to vendors for quotes and keep responses organized

Place orders and follow up with suppliers on status and tracking

Flag delays early and ask vendors for alternatives when an item is backordered

Keep purchasing records up to date



Executive and Sales Support

Manage calendars and schedule meetings, calls, and follow-ups

Book and coordinate travel including flights, accommodations, and itineraries

Keep CRM records updated and log outreach activity

Put together a simple weekly pipeline summary

Take on one-off requests and see them through without needing reminders



General Admin

Keep digital files and documentation organized

Manage subscriptions, renewals, and service providers

Coordinate with the bookkeeper and insurance broker as needed

Run the weekly check-in: come prepared with what you need and what’s coming up

Suggest improvements where you spot something inefficient



What We’re Looking For

Hands-on QuickBooks experience is required, including expense categorization and invoicing

Understanding of basic bookkeeping and how expenses map to a chart of accounts is required

Experience in an executive assistant, admin, or coordination role within a company is required — freelance marketplace work alone will not be enough

Experience supporting U.S.-based clients or teams is required

Fluent written and spoken English with confident client and vendor communication

Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail with the ability to manage several things at once

Able to work independently and manage your own day without being chased

Experience with vendor coordination, purchase orders, or order tracking is preferred

CRM and sales administration experience is preferred

Experience coordinating travel or calendars for senior leadership is preferred

Prior experience at an interior design or architecture firm is preferred



What We Offer

Full-time, long-term role

Paid Time Off (PTO)

Paid U.S. holiday leaves

Medical stipend after 3 months

Opportunity to grow into expanded responsibility over time

Clear opportunities for growth and professional development

Collaborative, supportive, and people-first work environment



Please submit your updated CV to apply. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

title: Accounting Supervisor ($5-6k/mo, PTO, 13th Month, PH Holidays)
description:
Pay: $5,000 to $6,000 USD a month

Schedule: Full time. Core hours 9am to 2pm US Eastern on working days.

Reports to: Senior Director, Operations. Works directly with the owner.



You are the person other accountants bring the problem to. The difference nobody can find. The intercompany balance that will not tie. The client who has run out of patience. You fix it, and then someone above you, who often knows less about it than you do, d
 what happens next. This job gives you the decisions.



About Monterra

Monterra is a US accounting and tax firm. We have served business owners since 1991. Most of our clients own many businesses at once: groups with ten, twenty or more locations, each its own company, with numbers that have to tie across all of them.



• Specialists. We have built the firm around owners of many businesses, so you spend your time on hard, interesting books instead of a long tail of one-off files.

• Thirty-five years, and growing. New multi-location groups signed with us this fall, and not one client has left us in the past year.

• We build our own tools. We wrote our own tax planning software, and we are rebuilding accounting the same way.

• Remote by design. The whole firm works remotely. You will not be the one person on a different clock in an office that forgot you exist.



The role

We have more good clients than we have people to serve them, so we are hiring one person to run our whole client accounting department: the team, the standards, the final review and the numbers. There is no partner to wait on. When you see a better way to run it, you have the authority to change it. We are rebuilding the department around automation, and you d
 what gets automated and write the procedure the team follows once it works.



What you will own

• The team: workloads, deadlines, coaching, hiring and performance for every accountant, in-house and outsourced

• Final technical review of every close and financial statement before it reaches a client

• One written method for every recurring task, plus a quality control program with monthly sample checks and an error log

• Hours against benchmark and realization for every client, reported to leadership on one page each month

• Onboarding each new client to a first clean close, and the client call when something goes wrong

• The automation rebuild, starting with bank reconciliation matching, and a second-in-command who can run the department without you



Requirements

We judge what you have done, not how long you did it. You must be able to show us:

• A team of accountants you ran for clients, and what changed because you ran it: closes that came in on time and errors that went down

• Your record as the final reviewer on other accountants' work: closes and financial statements for multi-entity groups

• A bank reconciliation you did yourself in the last twelve months

• A procedure you wrote that a team actually follows

• An outsourced or remote team you held to a standard, with numbers to prove it

• English strong enough to explain a set of financial statements, or a mistake in them, to a US business owner on a live call



Nice to have

• Franchise accounting, including 13-period calendars

• Thomson Reuters Accounting CS

• Accounting work you automated, and the hours it saved

You do not need a degree, a license, a particular title or a set number of years.



Pay and perks

• $5,000 to $6,000 USD a month, paid in US dollars wherever you live

• Annual bonus tied to your team's performance.

• Work from anywhere. Fully remote, in any country.

• Run your own day outside the core hours.

• A short line to the top. Your proposals go to the Senior Director, Operations and the owner, and you get an answer.

• Your own bench. You choose and develop the person who will be your number two.

• Paid time off. Two weeks to start, plus all US & PH holidays.



Your first year

• First 30 days: You learn every client and meet every accountant. You start on the bank reconciliations for our largest client group.

• By day 90: The buck stops with you on every client close and you run the weekly workload review. Your review standard and onboarding checklists are in use. Your first monthly report is sent.

• By month 6: Every recurring task has one written method. Monthly quality checks are running. Our outsourced partner is held to the hours and quality we agreed, with data.

• By month 12: You own the department. At least one automated workflow is live under your procedures. Someone on your team can run the department for two weeks while you are away.



How we hire

We do not screen on job titles or count your years. We ask what you did, with numbers, and who can confirm it.

1. Application. About 35 minutes. Three short accounting tests and questions about your results. No cover letter.

2. Work test one. A month-end close review, a bank reconciliation and a written procedure, built from the work you would own here. About 2.5 hours.

3. Work test two. Your first weeks in the seat, in one data pack. About 2.5 hours.

4. Interview with the owner. We contact your references after the interview, not before.



Every application gets a reply. You will never wait weeks in silence wondering whether anyone read your work.



How to apply

Apply here: 
/dcas-application. There is one seat.

title: Real Estate Acquisition Specialist – U.S. Wholesaling (Remote)
description:
We are a growing U.S.-based real estate investment and wholesaling company looking for motivated, confident, and competitive Acquisition Representatives to join our team long-term.



Our acquisition model is primarily agent-based. Instead of spending your day cold calling homeowners, you will communicate with U.S. real estate agents to identify investment opportunities, build relationships, submit offers, negotiate deals, and get properties under contract.



This is a sales and negotiation role, not a traditional virtual assistant position.





What You'll Be Doing:



Your primary responsibility is to generate contracts through relationships and conversations with real estate agents.



You will:



- Call and communicate with U.S. real estate agents

- Build relationships with agents and become a reliable investor contact

- Identify potential investment opportunities

- Discuss properties, pricing, seller situations, and offer terms

- Make and follow up on offers

- Negotiate pricing and terms

- Handle objections and counteroffers professionally

- Consistently follow up with agents and previously submitted offers

- Maintain an organized pipeline in our CRM

- Work with our team to evaluate opportunities and determine appropriate offer prices

- Move qualified opportunities toward signed contracts

- Meet activity and performance KPIs



You will have support from our team throughout the entire process. You are not expected to know or handle every part of a real estate transaction yourself. Your primary focus is acquisitions.





Who We're Looking For:



We are looking for someone who can sell.



The ideal candidate is:



- Fluent or highly proficient in spoken and written English

- Confident speaking with American real estate professionals

- Comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls

- Professional and personable on the phone

- Strong at building relationships

- Comfortable negotiating and asking direct questions

- Persistent with follow-up

- Able to handle rejection without losing motivation

- Competitive and motivated by results

- Organized and capable of managing a pipeline

- Coachable and willing to follow an established process

- Reliable and consistent

- Interested in a long-term opportunity with significant earning potential



Previous experience in U.S. real estate, wholesaling, acquisitions, agent outreach, cold calling, appointment setting, or phone sales is strongly preferred.



However, you do not need to already be a real estate or wholesaling expert. We care more about your communication skills, sales ability, confidence, work ethic, coachability, and willingness to learn.





Compensation:



Compensation consists of a $100 USD guaranteed monthly base salary + 10% commission on qualifying deals you acquire that successfully close and generate revenue for the company.



There is no cap on commission earnings. This is a heavily performance-based sales position, so the majority of your earning potential comes from successfully generating deals.



Examples of commission earnings:



- $10,000 closed deal = $1,000 commission

- $20,000 closed deal = $2,000 commission

- $30,000 closed deal = $3,000 commission

- $50,000 closed deal = $5,000 commission



The $100 monthly base salary is guaranteed, while commissions are earned on qualifying deals after the transaction successfully closes and the company receives the funds. Full compensation and commission terms will be provided before starting.



This compensation structure is best suited for someone who is confident in their sales ability, motivated by performance, and wants the opportunity to earn significantly more through results.





What We Provide



You will be joining an existing real estate operation with a team, systems, technology, and processes already in place.



We provide:



- Agent leads/data

- Phone/calling system

- CRM and established acquisition systems

- Full acquisitions training

- Hands-on training and support

- Scripts and processes

- Property analysis and comping support

- Offer guidance

- Negotiation support

- Transaction coordination

- Disposition/buyer support

- Technology and system support

- Ongoing coaching and team communication



You are not expected to figure out the business on your own.



Our training is relatively quick but thorough. We will teach you our process step by step, and you will work alongside the owner and our existing team as you get started.



If you have a question, need help evaluating an opportunity, aren't sure how to respond to an agent, need assistance with a negotiation, or encounter something you haven't seen before, someone on the team will be available to help and step in when necessary.



Your job is to become excellent at the front end of the business: talking to agents, building relationships, finding opportunities, following up, negotiating, and getting contracts signed.



We handle and support the rest.





Schedule:



Because we primarily communicate with U.S.-based real estate agents, you must be available consistently during U.S. business hours.



We are looking for people who can dedicate meaningful, consistent time to the position and want to build a long-term role within the company.





Growth Opportunity:



We are actively growing our real estate operation and entering additional U.S. markets.



Strong performers will have opportunities to take on more responsibility as the company grows. We want to develop people who can consistently generate deals and eventually become key members of our acquisitions team.



This is a performance-driven sales position. If you are competitive, confident on the phone, motivated by commission, and want your income to increase based on the results you produce, we want to hear from you.





How to Apply:



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself.

2. A description of your sales experience.

3. Any experience you have with U.S. real estate, wholesaling, acquisitions, real estate agents, cold calling, or phone sales.

4. A voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why you believe you would be successful in this role.

5. Your availability and the U.S. hours you are able to work.



At the end of your application, include the word “CLOSER” so we know you read the entire posting.



Please make sure you understand the compensation structure before applying: $100 USD guaranteed monthly base salary + 10% commission on qualifying closed deals, with uncapped commission earning potential.

title: Amazon Supervisor
description:
Amazon Supervisor



Work Setup: Remote / Work From Home  

Department: Amazon Operations  

Reports To: Amazon Manager



About the Role



We are looking for an experienced Amazon Supervisor to oversee daily Amazon operations and ensure the team consistently delivers accurate, efficient, and high-quality work.



The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of Amazon Seller Central, product listing management, FBA inventory, account health, sales performance, and advertising metrics. This person will supervise daily workflows, monitor team performance, resolve operational issues, and coordinate with other departments to keep Amazon operations running smoothly.



You will work closely with the Amazon Manager to execute business strategies, improve operational efficiency, and support the company's continued growth in the Amazon marketplace.



Key Responsibilities



1. Amazon Store & Listing Management

- Supervise the creation, maintenance, and optimization of Amazon product listings.

- Ensure product titles, bullet points, descriptions, images, A+ content, pricing, and variations are accurate and updated.

- Monitor listing quality, keyword optimization, organic rankings, and catalog performance.

- Identify and resolve listing errors, suppressed listings, and catalog issues.

- Ensure listing updates and optimization tasks are completed accurately and on time.



2. Sales & Performance Monitoring

- Monitor daily and weekly sales, traffic, conversion rates, and overall store performance.

- Track sales performance against targets and identify underperforming products.

- Coordinate the implementation of approved promotions, deals, coupons, and pricing updates.

- Analyze sales trends and recommend opportunities to improve product visibility and conversions.

- Prepare regular performance reports and provide actionable insights to the Amazon Manager.



3. Inventory & FBA Operations

- Monitor FBA inventory levels, stock availability, and inventory health.

- Coordinate with Supply Chain and inventory planning teams on replenishment requirements.

- Identify potential stockouts, excess inventory, aged inventory, and stranded inventory.

- Follow up on inventory-related concerns and ensure timely resolution.

- Help maintain healthy inventory levels and product availability across Amazon marketplaces.



4. Amazon Account Health & Compliance

- Monitor Account Health, policy notifications, listing suppressions, and other account-related issues.

- Ensure compliance with Amazon policies, marketplace requirements, and internal procedures.

- Coordinate the resolution of account performance issues, listing violations, and customer-related concerns.

- Manage follow-ups on cases submitted to Amazon Seller Support.

- Escalate critical account risks, policy violations, and potential suspensions to the Amazon Manager.



5. Advertising & Campaign Monitoring

- Monitor Amazon PPC campaigns and advertising performance in coordination with the responsible team.

- Review advertising metrics, including ACOS, ROAS, TACOS, and ad-driven sales.

- Track campaign budgets, keyword performance, and opportunities for optimization.

- Coordinate approved campaign adjustments and promotional activities.

- Identify underperforming campaigns and communicate recommendations to the Amazon Manager.



6. Team Supervision & Workflow Management

- Supervise daily team activities, task assignments, priorities, and deadlines.

- Monitor individual productivity, work quality, and adherence to established procedures.

- Review completed tasks to ensure accuracy and consistency.

- Provide guidance, coaching, and constructive feedback to team members.

- Follow up on pending tasks and ensure deliverables are completed on schedule.

- Identify recurring operational problems and recommend process improvements.

- Promote accountability, clear communication, and continuous improvement within the team.



7. Reporting & Cross-Department Coordination

- Prepare and maintain regular reports, trackers, and documentation related to Amazon operations.

- Coordinate with Supply Chain, Product Development, Marketing, and other relevant departments.

- Communicate operational concerns, delays, and performance trends to the Amazon Manager.

- Track action items and ensure timely follow-up across departments.

- Recommend improvements to workflows, reporting, and day-to-day operations.



Qualifications & Requirements



- Proven experience in Amazon Seller Central and e-commerce operations.

- Previous experience in a supervisory, team lead, or operations leadership role 

- Strong understanding of Amazon product listing management, catalog maintenance, and listing optimization.

- Experience with FBA inventory management, replenishment coordination, and inventory health monitoring.

- Familiarity with Amazon Account Health, policy compliance, and Seller Support cases.

- Knowledge of Amazon PPC advertising and metrics such as ACOS, ROAS, and TACOS.

- Ability to analyze sales reports, identify performance trends, and recommend operational improvements.

- Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

- Ability to manage multiple tasks, meet deadlines, and supervise team deliverables.

- Proficiency in spreadsheets, reporting tools, and e-commerce management systems.

- Comfortable working independently in a remote environment while coordinating with a distributed team.



 What We’re Looking For



- A hands-on leader who can manage daily operations while maintaining high standards of accuracy and quality.

- Someone who takes ownership of tasks, follows through on commitments, and holds the team accountable.

- A proactive problem-solver who can identify issues before they become major operational concerns.

- A detail-oriented individual who is comfortable working with data, reports, and performance metrics.

- A collaborative team player who can coordinate effectively with management and other departments.



 How to Apply



If you have experience in Amazon operations and enjoy leading a team, improving processes, and supporting e-commerce growth, we would love to hear from you.



Please submit your updated resume highlighting your relevant Amazon experience, leadership responsibilities, and key accomplishments.

title: Supply Chain Assistant
description:
Supply Chain Assistant – Order Fulfillment & E-commerce Operations



About the Role:



EVORETRO is looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Supply Chain Assistant to support our daily supply chain operations, with a primary focus on order fulfillment, order processing, and shipment monitoring.



The ideal candidate has at least two years of experience in supply chain operations, order fulfillment, logistics, or e-commerce operations. Experience working with online retail businesses and using Cin7 inventory and order management software is highly preferred.



In this role, you will help ensure orders are processed accurately, shipments are monitored, inventory information is maintained, and fulfillment issues are addressed promptly. You will also provide general operational and administrative support to the Supply Chain Supervisor to help keep daily operations organized and efficient.



Key Responsibilities



1. Order Fulfillment and Processing

- Process and monitor daily orders to ensure accurate and timely fulfillment.

- Verify order details, product information, quantities, and shipping information before processing.

- Monitor order status from processing through shipment and delivery.

- Coordinate with warehouses, fulfillment partners, and logistics providers to ensure orders are dispatched on time.

- Identify and follow up on pending, delayed, incomplete, or problematic orders.

- Investigate order discrepancies and coordinate with the appropriate teams to resolve fulfillment issues.

- Maintain accurate order records and update fulfillment trackers and systems.

- Escalate recurring order fulfillment issues to the Supply Chain Supervisor.



2. Inventory and Cin7 Management

- Use Cin7 or similar inventory management systems to monitor orders, stock availability, and inventory records.

- Update and verify order and inventory information in the system.

- Assist in identifying stock discrepancies, low-stock items, and inventory-related fulfillment issues.

- Coordinate with relevant teams regarding product availability and stock concerns.

- Help ensure inventory information is accurate and up to date to support order fulfillment.



3. Logistics and Shipment Coordination



- Assist in coordinating inbound and outbound shipments.

- Monitor shipment schedules, tracking information, and delivery timelines.

- Follow up with logistics providers and fulfillment partners regarding delayed, missing, or incomplete shipments.

- Maintain accurate shipping documentation and tracking records.

- Communicate shipment updates and delivery concerns to the relevant internal teams.

- Help resolve logistics issues that may affect order fulfillment.



4. General Supply Chain Support



- Assist the Supply Chain Supervisor with daily operational and administrative tasks.

- Maintain spreadsheets, reports, order trackers, and supply chain documentation.

- Coordinate with Customer Service, Amazon, and other internal departments regarding order, shipment, and inventory concerns.

- Assist in monitoring pending tasks and following up on outstanding operational matters.

- Identify recurring workflow issues and suggest practical improvements.

- Perform other related duties as assigned to support the Supply Chain Department.



Qualifications and Requirements



- At least 2 years of relevant experience in supply chain operations, order fulfillment, logistics coordination, or a similar role.

- Experience in e-commerce, online retail, or online store operations is highly preferred

- Experience using Cin7 is highly preferred

- Familiarity with inventory management systems, order management platforms, and fulfillment workflows.

- Knowledge of order processing, shipment tracking, stock monitoring, and logistics coordination.

- Proficiency in Google Sheets, Microsoft Excel, and other productivity tools.

- Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate records.

- Good written and verbal communication skills.

- Strong organizational and time management skills.

- Ability to manage multiple orders and priorities while meeting deadlines.

- Proactive in identifying discrepancies, following up on pending orders, and escalating issues when necessary.

- Able to work independently in a remote setup while collaborating effectively with the team.



What We Are Looking For::



We are looking for someone who is hands-on, organized, dependable, and comfortable managing the day-to-day details of order fulfillment.



The successful candidate should be able to monitor orders consistently, maintain accurate records, follow up on outstanding shipments, and coordinate with different teams to ensure orders move smoothly through the fulfillment process.



We value accuracy, accountability, proactive communication, and a strong sense of ownership over assigned tasks.



How to Apply:



Please submit your updated resume and include a brief summary of your relevant experience, particularly in the following areas:



1. Order Fulfillment: Describe your experience processing and monitoring orders from placement to shipment.

2. Cin7 Experience: Have you used Cin7? If yes, please describe the tasks you handled using the system.

3. E-commerce Experience: What online retail platforms or e-commerce businesses have you supported?

4. Inventory and Logistics: Briefly describe your experience with inventory tracking, shipment coordination, or fulfillment partners.



Please highlight your hands-on order fulfillment experience and the systems you have used in your application.



We look forward to hearing from qualified candidates!

title: TRANSPORTATION DISPATCHER
description:
Company: Buffalo Transportation

Industry: Non-Emergency Medical Transportation (NEMT)

Position: Transportation Dispatcher



Job Description



Buffalo Transportation is looking for a reliable, organized, and detail-oriented Transportation Dispatcher to join our growing team.



The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator, can multitask in a fast-paced environment, and has strong problem-solving skills. The dispatcher will be responsible for coordinating daily transportation operations, managing driver schedules, monitoring trips, and ensuring passengers receive safe, reliable, and timely transportation.



Key Responsibilities



Coordinate and manage daily transportation schedules and driver assignments.



Use RouteGenie dispatch software to schedule trips, optimize routes, and monitor transportation operations.



Monitor drivers and vehicles in real time to ensure timely pickups and drop-offs.



Communicate with drivers regarding assignments, schedule changes, delays, and emergencies.



Coordinate medical transportation trips, including appointments scheduled through MAS (Medical Answering Services).



Respond promptly to incoming calls, driver inquiries, and passenger concerns.



Handle last-minute cancellations, no-shows, and scheduling adjustments.



Resolve transportation issues quickly and professionally.



Maintain accurate dispatch records, trip information, and operational reports.



Coordinate with management to improve efficiency, reduce delays, and maintain high service standards.



Ensure all transportation assignments follow company policies and applicable safety requirements.



Qualifications & Requirements



Previous experience in transportation dispatch, logistics, or scheduling is preferred.



Experience with RouteGenie or similar dispatch software is a strong advantage.



Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal.



Excellent organizational and multitasking abilities.



Ability to remain calm and make quick decisions under pressure.



Strong computer skills and ability to learn new software quickly.



Excellent attention to detail and problem-solving skills.



Reliable, punctual, and responsible.



Ability to work independently and collaborate with a team.



Experience in medical transportation (NEMT) is a plus.



What We're Looking For



We are looking for someone who:



Takes ownership of their responsibilities.



Can manage multiple drivers and trips simultaneously.



Communicates clearly and professionally.



Works efficiently in a busy dispatch environment.



Is proactive in identifying and resolving potential problems.



Understands the importance of punctuality, accountability, and excellent customer service.



What We Offer:



Competitive compensation based on experience.



Training on company dispatch procedures and software.



Supportive and professional team environment.



Opportunity for professional development and growth.



Long-term employment opportunities.



How to Apply



Interested candidates should submit their resume along with a brief description of their dispatching or transportation experience.



Subject: Transportation Dispatcher – Application



Join Buffalo Transportation and help us provide reliable and efficient transportation services to our community!
