title: Business Systems & Process Improvement Specialist
description:
Business Systems & Process Improvement Specialist



Job Type:*Full-Time  

Work Setup: Remote / Work From Home  

Location: Philippines  

Reports To:CEO and COO



 Job Overview



EVORETRO / DistribuClic is looking for a proactive and tech-savvy Business Systems & Process Improvement Specialist to help streamline company operations, implement new systems, improve workflows, and explore AI and automation solutions.



You will work directly with the CEO and COO on various business improvement initiatives and system projects. Your role will involve identifying operational challenges, researching solutions, implementing tools, documenting processes, and coordinating with different departments to ensure improvements are successfully carried out.



We are looking for someone who is both analytical and hands-on—someone who can turn ideas into practical solutions, work independently, and take ownership of projects from planning to implementation.



Responsibilities



- Identify opportunities to improve business processes, workflows, and operational efficiency.

- Research, evaluate, and implement software, digital tools, and business systems.

- Explore AI tools and automation solutions to reduce repetitive manual tasks.

- Improve existing workflows and help integrate systems used across different departments.

- Gather requirements from the CEO, COO, and relevant teams to understand business needs.

- Coordinate system setup, testing, implementation, and adoption.

- Create and maintain SOPs, workflow diagrams, process documentation, and user guides.

- Manage and coordinate system implementation projects and other special initiatives.

- Track project progress, timelines, deliverables, and pending action items.

- Follow up with departments and stakeholders to ensure projects move forward.

- Research operational challenges and recommend practical, technology-driven solutions.

- Provide regular updates to management on project progress, issues, and proposed improvements.

- Stay updated on emerging technologies, AI applications, and automation tools that may benefit the company.



Qualifications



- Experience in business systems implementation, process improvement, workflow automation, project coordination, or a related field.

- Hands-on experience setting up, implementing, or improving software and digital tools.

- Familiarity with AI tools, automation platforms, and system integrations.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

- Ability to understand business processes and identify opportunities for improvement.

- Good project coordination, organization, and time management skills.

- Ability to create clear SOPs, workflows, and process documentation.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills.

- Comfortable working directly with senior leadership and coordinating with different departments.

- Self-motivated, resourceful, detail-oriented, and capable of working independently.

- Willingness to learn new tools and explore different solutions to business challenges.



Preferred Skills



- Experience with Asana

- Familiarity with automation platforms and AI-powered applications.

- Experience with CRM, inventory management, e-commerce, or other business systems.

- Experience implementing process improvements or introducing new systems in a growing company.

- Experience working remotely with teams across different departments.



Who We Are Looking For



We need someone who takes initiative, enjoys solving problems, and can move beyond simply suggesting improvements.



You should be comfortable researching a solution, testing tools, setting up systems, documenting processes, coordinating with stakeholders, and ensuring that the solution works in practice.



You do not need to be a people manager. We are looking for a hands-on specialist who can work independently, collaborate with leadership, and help the company operate more efficiently through better systems, processes, and technology.



How to Apply



Please submit your resume and a brief introduction highlighting your relevant experience.



In your application, please answer the following questions:



1. What systems, software, or automation tools have you personally implemented or improved?

2. Describe one business process or workflow you streamlined. What problem did you solve, what tools did you use, and what was the result?

3. What AI tools or automation platforms have you used to improve productivity or reduce manual work?



Applications that include specific examples of hands-on implementation and process improvement will be prioritized.

title: Experienced B2B Cold Caller / Appointment Setter – U.S. Company
description:
Employment Type: Full-Time, Remote

Schedule: Monday–Friday, U.S. Eastern Time

Hours: 40 hours per week

Compensation: $5–$8 USD per hour, depending on experience and demonstrated ability

Location: Philippines



About FP Supplies



FP Supplies is a growing U.S.-based supplier serving construction contractors, property managers, real estate investors and other commercial customers.



We are looking for an experienced and dependable cold caller to generate qualified opportunities and schedule appointments for our existing sales team.



This is not an entry-level position. You must already be comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls, speaking with U.S. business customers, handling objections and consistently working toward daily and weekly goals.



Your Role



Your primary responsibility will be to contact prospective customers, introduce FP Supplies, identify potential purchasing needs and schedule qualified appointments or follow-up calls for our sales team.



You will not be responsible for independently closing complex sales. Our existing sales representatives will handle detailed product discussions, quotations and closing.



Responsibilities

Make approximately 150–200 outbound calls per day using our provided calling lists and VoIP dialer

Contact construction contractors, property managers, real estate investors and other business prospects

Follow FP Supplies’ calling scripts and sales process

Introduce the company clearly and professionally

Ask qualifying questions to identify potential customer needs

Build rapport quickly with business owners, purchasing contacts and property-management professionals

Handle common objections confidently and professionally

Schedule qualified appointments and follow-up conversations for our sales team

Accurately record call outcomes, notes and follow-up information in HubSpot

Maintain accurate lead statuses and customer information

Follow up with prospects when requested

Meet daily and weekly goals for calls, conversations and qualified appointments

Attend training, coaching and team meetings as required

Required Qualifications

At least two years of inside-sales, outbound-sales, telemarketing, cold-calling or appointment-setting experience

Excellent spoken English that is clear and easily understood by U.S. customers

Confident and professional telephone presence

Experience making high-volume outbound calls

Strong ability to build rapport and keep prospects engaged

Ability to handle rejection and objections without becoming discouraged

Reliable, organized and consistent

Comfortable working independently with limited supervision

Able to follow scripts while still sounding natural and conversational

Comfortable being measured against activity and appointment goals

Available to work during U.S. Eastern Time business hours

Preferred Experience



The following experience is strongly preferred but not required:



B2B cold calling

Construction, HVAC, building materials or contractor-related campaigns

Property management or real estate

Calling business owners and purchasing decision-makers

HubSpot or another CRM platform

VoIP dialers, power dialers or automated calling systems

Working remotely for a U.S.-based company

Technology Requirements



You must provide and maintain your own:



Reliable computer capable of running web-based calling and CRM software

Professional-quality headset with a clear microphone

High-speed and dependable internet connection

Quiet and professional home-working environment

Backup internet or power solution preferred



FP Supplies will provide:



Calling lists

Access to our VoIP dialer

Call scripts and training

Access to the necessary sales systems

Ongoing coaching and support from our U.S. team

Compensation and Opportunity

Starting compensation of $5–$7 USD per hour, based on experience and demonstrated ability

Full-time, long-term opportunity

Performance will be measured using clear call, conversation and appointment goals

Strong performers may become eligible for performance incentives, increased compensation and additional responsibilities

How to Apply



Please include all of the following with your application:



A link to a 60–90 second Vocaroo or Loom recording introducing yourself

A summary of your cold-calling and inside-sales experience

The industries or campaigns you have previously called for

Your average number of outbound calls per day in your most recent calling position

The appointment or lead-generation goals you were expected to meet

The CRM and calling systems you have used

Your internet speed-test results

Your computer and headset specifications

Confirmation that you can work Monday–Friday during U.S. Eastern Time

Your requested hourly rate in U.S. dollars



In your voice recording, please explain why your previous experience has prepared you to call construction contractors, property managers and business owners.



Begin your application with the words “FP COLD CALLER” so we know you carefully read the complete job description.



Applications without a voice recording will not be considered.

title: Full-Time Social Media Manager & AI Content Creator
description:
Remote | Philippines-Based



We’re looking for a creative, reliable social media professional who knows how to use AI effectively, thinks independently, and can turn ideas into polished content.



You’ll work directly with the founder supporting two software businesses: one in logistics and transportation, and another in AI-powered visual entertainment and projection mapping. Company details will be shared with shortlisted applicants.



We need someone who can understand our products, learn the styles we like, suggest ideas, and take content from concept to publication.



Your Responsibilities



* Plan and maintain content calendars for two distinct brands.

* Create short-form videos, reels, graphics, captions, product demonstrations, and tutorials.

* Turn raw footage, screen recordings, rough notes, and customer examples into engaging content.

* Develop a consistent voice and visual style for each brand.

* Bring fresh ideas and take initiative without needing step-by-step instructions for every task.

* Schedule and publish approved content across our priority social channels.

* Monitor comments and messages, handle routine questions, and escalate issues appropriately.

* Track performance and use the results to improve future content.

* Keep content, project files, and assets organized.



What We’re Looking For



Proven Experience



You have created content and managed social media for businesses. You must provide work samples and clearly explain your personal contribution. Results supported by analytics are a plus.



AI Skills With Strong Judgment



You use AI for more than copying and pasting answers. You can refine prompts, improve drafts, verify information, maintain brand consistency, and recognize weak or inaccurate output. You remain responsible for the quality of the finished work.



Strong Video Editing and Design Skills



You understand hooks, pacing, captions, composition, and visual storytelling. Experience with tools such as CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Canva, or Adobe applications is welcome. The quality of your work matters more than which tools you use.



Practical Social Media Knowledge



You understand how content should differ across
, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and LinkedIn. You know how to use scheduling tools, analytics, audience engagement, and calls to action.



Ability to Learn Our Style



You can study references, understand what we like, apply feedback, and consistently create content that fits each brand.



Strong English and Communication



You can write natural, engaging English and communicate clearly about progress, deadlines, and questions.



Reliability and Ownership



You meet deadlines, follow through, and flag problems early. You have a computer capable of editing video, reliable internet, and a practical backup plan for power or connectivity interruptions.



Experience with software, technology, logistics, or visual entertainment is helpful but not required.



Working Arrangement



* Full-time, remote role for someone based in the Philippines.

* Consistent availability and agreed working hours.

* Some overlap with the founder’s Atlantic Standard Time working hours (UTC−4); exact schedule discussed during the interview.

* Compensation based on experience and demonstrated ability. Include your expected monthly rate and currency.



How to Apply



Please send:



* A short video introduction about yourself. Tell us a little about who you are, your experience, and why you think you’d be a good fit for this role. This does not need to be professionally produced—we want to get a sense of your personality, communication style, and how you present yourself.

* A short written introduction explaining why you’re a good fit.

* Your résumé or relevant work history.

* Links to 3–5 strong content samples, including short-form video. Explain what you personally created.

* Examples of business social accounts you have managed and any results you can substantiate. Redacted analytics screenshots are welcome.

title: Advertising Specialist, Amazon & Other Marketplaces
description:
About us

We sell our own brands on Amazon and other online marketplaces, across around twenty storefronts in North America, Europe and Japan. We are building an internal marketplace operations team to run advertising, listings, account operations and analysis.



The role

We are hiring 2-3 advertising specialists to run advertising across our Amazon and other marketplace accounts. You will be responsible for campaign performance and advertising account health in the markets assigned to you.



What you will own



Data health. Keyword tags, product tags, Search Query Performance reporting, and an AMC overview once AMC is in place. Reporting and decisions depend on this data being correct.

The AI analyst. Our in-house AI analyst proposes account changes. You schedule it, assess what it proposes, action or reject each change, and review what it got right and wrong. You maintain your own areas of the knowledge base, split by account and region.

Campaign preparation and launch. Build and launch campaigns using our own tooling, with bulk operations throughout.

Campaign hygiene. Daily and weekly checks covering budget pacing, targeting, bid adjustments and negative keyword harvesting.

DSP and AMC. Create orders and line items, run upper funnel activity, and build audiences.

Product pages and Brand Stores. Advise on and recommend best practices for product detail pages, Brand Stores and brand pages on other platforms, alongside other team members.

Non-PPC activity. Advise on CPM and brand activity such as Amazon Live and Creator Connections.

New platforms. Set up advertising on new marketplaces as we add them, and document how each one works so the setup can be repeated.

Stakeholders. Present to stakeholders and assess the proposals they bring.



About you

You work carefully and understand that a small mistake can waste a large budget. You follow checklists so nothing is missed, and you flag when a checklist needs changing.

You analyse before you act. When a figure moves, you break it down, separate a rate change from a mix change, rule causes out, and can explain what you eliminated and why.



What every role in the team needs



Works into the detail beyond the headline figure

Can do the work from first principles, without AI

Questions and challenges AI output

Breaks a movement down into its causes

Attention to detail



What this role needs



At least 2 years of hands-on Amazon advertising experience

A clear advertising approach that you can explain and defend

Ability to manage large catalogues and campaigns effectively

Can build a bulk file by hand

Looks beyond advertising data into Category trends, SQP, and other analytics

Can judge a proposed change from the AI analyst

Strong command of the Amazon Ads console

Advanced Excel: VLOOKUPs, pivot tables



Nice to have



DSP and AMC

DataDive or similar

Advertising on retail media platforms outside Amazon, such as eBay, Bol, ManoMano or Walmart

A European language: German, French, Italian or Dutch

Office 365, Teams, PowerPoint

Claude



Process

An introductory call with the Amazon and marketplaces lead, then a live second interview with analysis exercises on real data. 



How to apply

Full time, remote, UK hours.

Every applicant answered fast and professionally. Units leasing faster with a clean CRM. Vendors coordinated, the owner's inbox and phone handled, the team running smoothly, nothing slipping.

title: e-Commerce Virtual Assistant
description:
Our remote team is growing, and we need an eCommerce VA who is reliable, self-driven, and sharp with details, someone who wants a real career with us, not just a stopgap. We run the daily operations of online brands for clients around the world, and you'll support several of them at once. No two days look alike. Expect busy task lists, last-minute changes, fast turnarounds, and priorities that shift quickly. We need someone who stays organized, follows our processes, handles pressure well, and keeps quality high when things get hectic.



Role details:

- Start date: as soon as possible

- Full-time, long-term

- Graveyard shift (Philippine time), Monday to Friday

- Weekends off

- Occasionally, we may ask for extra hours for urgent client requests or deadlines. It won't be every day, but flexibility matters in our fast-paced setting.



What you'll do:

- Run and maintain Shopify, WooCommerce, and Amazon stores

- Build, edit, and optimize product listings

- Research products, competitors, and market trends

- Help with customer support and order handling

- Keep websites updated and take care of general admin

- Support our marketing and content work

- Create simple graphics and marketing visuals in Canva

- Make basic layout and design improvements to websites

- Use ChatGPT and other AI tools to work faster and more accurately

- Follow our systems, SOPs, checklists, and instructions

- Manage tasks across multiple client accounts

- Respond quickly to updates and requests during your shift

- Keep your work organized and on time during busy periods



As you prove your reliability, we'll give you more: greater independence with client accounts and bigger, higher-value projects.



Who we're looking for:

- You have hands-on Shopify experience: product listings, store updates, theme edits, and order management

- You learn fast and can figure things out on your own

- You're highly organized with a sharp eye for detail

- You own your work and take accountability for results

- You follow instructions closely and meet deadlines

- You communicate clearly and professionally

- You're hardworking and proactive

- You thrive in a fast-moving environment

- You stay calm and professional with urgent requests

- You have a reliable laptop or desktop and a stable, fast internet connection

- You're fully available for the entire shift

- You have no other job, clients, business, or personal commitments that could affect your availability, focus, or performance



Bonus skills (not required):

- Experience with WooCommerce, Amazon, or TikTok Shop

- Canva or basic graphic design skills

- A good eye for clean layouts and visual presentation

- Experience with ChatGPT or other AI tools

- Basic video editing in CapCut

- A background in virtual assistance, eCommerce, customer service, or admin work



Beyond Shopify, experience isn't everything. We value discipline, attitude, consistency, honesty, and reliability over years on a resume. We can teach you the other platforms and tools, but the right mindset and commitment have to come from you on day one.



Pay and growth:

- Monthly salary: ₱28,000 to ₱32,000

- Monthly performance incentive: up to ₱5,000, based on performance

- ₱1,500 signing bonus after completing the probationary period

-₱2,500 referral bonus for every person you refer who gets hired and passes probation

-Regular salary increases based on performance

- A clear path to promotion and bigger responsibilities

- Room to grow into senior and leadership roles

- Long-term stability for consistent top performers



Why join us:

- Build a stable, long-term career with an established eCommerce agency

- Work within clear systems and processes

- Get proper guidance, training, and regular performance feedback

- Gain hands-on skills in Shopify, Amazon, WooCommerce, and TikTok Shop

- Work with AI, automation, and modern digital tools

- Get real experience with international eCommerce brands

- Develop skills that lead to senior and leadership positions



This isn't for everyone

We're not looking for someone who waits to be told what to do and does only the minimum. We want someone who takes initiative, works smart, thinks critically, stays focused, and owns the outcome. The work can get intense and priorities can change fast, so you need to be comfortable adapting and handling several responsibilities at once without letting quality drop. Above all, we want someone who plans to grow with us for the long haul.



If you're after a temporary gig, side income, an easy job, or something to do on top of another commitment, this probably isn't the right fit.



How to apply

Please send us:

- Your updated resume

- A screenshot of your internet speed test

- Your computer specs: device or model, processor, RAM, and storage

- A short cover letter introducing yourself, sharing your relevant experience (especially your Shopify work), and telling us why you're the right person for this role



Important: Put "ECOMMERCE VA - (YOUR NAME)" in your
 subject line. Applications without it may be skipped, since it shows us you read the full post.



One last thing

This is a long-term role with real room to grow. We're looking for someone ready to fully commit and become a reliable part of our team. You must not have other jobs, clients, or commitments that could get in the way of your schedule, availability, focus, productivity, or performance.



If you're disciplined, driven, eager to learn, and ready to build a serious career in eCommerce, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Amazon Financial & Competitor Analyst
description:
About us

We sell our own brands on Amazon and other online marketplaces, across around twenty storefronts in North America, Europe and Japan. We are building an internal marketplace operations team to run advertising, listings, account operations and analysis.



The role

This role covers finance and competitor analysis. On the finance side: our pricing, profitability, Amazon fees as a share of our sales, and ways to improve our margins. On the competitor side: who competes with us, what they charge and what they run, and what that means for our pricing and range.



What you will own



Finance



Pricing. Our prices across marketplaces and against competitors, and the margin effect of each change.

Pricing strategy. Own the pricing strategy recommendations for one of our brands, with the reasoning behind each one.

Profitability. Profit by product and marketplace, after Amazon fees, advertising and returns.

Margin improvement. Advise on and recommend ways to improve profit margins, including packaging, fulfilment, couriers, 3PLs and other operational costs.

Amazon fees. Every Amazon and marketplace fee as a share of our sales, when it changes and why. This includes checking our FBA fees and product measurements against Amazon’s figures.



Competitor strategy and analysis



Competitor monitoring. New competitors as they appear, their prices, deals and promotions, and changes to their range and listings.

Competitor strategy. Recommendations on our pricing, range and promotions based on competitor activity, shared with the advertising and operations specialists.



About you

You are careful with numbers. You check a figure before you report it, and you can trace any number in a report back to its source.

You explain numbers simply to people who do not work with them, and you base pricing and promotion recommendations on data.



What every role in the team needs



Works into the detail beyond the headline figure

Can do the work from first principles, without AI

Questions and challenges AI output

Breaks a movement down into its causes

Attention to detail



What this role needs



At least 2 years in a finance or commercial analyst role, ideally on Amazon or other marketplaces

Builds and reads a profit and loss by product

Knows Amazon’s fee structure: referral, FBA, storage and surcharges

Uses competitor and market tools to track prices, sellers and deals

Ability to work with large catalogues and data sets effectively

Advanced Excel: VLOOKUPs, pivot tables



Nice to have



Keepa or similar price-history tools

Amazon deals and coupons experience

Power BI or similar

Office 365, Teams, PowerPoint

Claude



Process

An introductory call with the Amazon and marketplaces lead, then a live second interview with analysis exercises on real data.



How to apply

Send your CV and a short message about your experience, including the marketplaces and countries you have worked on.



Hours

Full time, remote, UK hours.

title: Affiliate Manager — Research Peptide Brand
description:
Location: Remote

Type: Full-Time

Reports To: Director of Operations / Founder

Compensation: Base + performance bonus tied to affiliate-driven revenue (DOE)



About Us



We are a fast-growing research peptide brand serving the research and scientific community. Our products are sold for research and laboratory use, and we operate at the intersection of life sciences, e-commerce, and creator-driven marketing. We’re scaling our affiliate program aggressively and need an operator who can build relationships, run high-volume outreach, and treat compliance as non-negotiable.



Role Overview



The Affiliate Manager owns the day-to-day operation and growth of our affiliate program end-to-end. You will manage the existing affiliate roster, source and recruit new micro-influencers (primarily fitness, biohacking, and research-adjacent creators in the 1K–5K follower range on Instagram and TikTok), and drive measurable lift in affiliate-attributed revenue. This is a builder role — heavy on outreach, relationship management, and operational rigor — not a sit-back-and-track-numbers role.



Key Responsibilities



1. Affiliate Recruitment & Sourcing



a. Identify and prospect micro-influencers in the 1K–5K Instagram/TikTok follower range across fitness, bodybuilding, biohacking, longevity, and research-adjacent niches.

b. Build and maintain a sourcing pipeline using tools such as Modash, Heepsy, Upfluence, Shoutcart, or manual hashtag/competitor scraping

c. Run high-volume cold outreach via DM,
, and creator platforms; manage response rates, follow-up cadences, and conversion-to-onboarded metrics

d. Identify lookalike creators based on top-performing existing affiliates

e. Monitor competitor affiliate rosters and recruit overlapping or adjacent talent



2. Affiliate Relationship Management



a. Own the relationship with every affiliate in the program — be the single point of contact for questions, payouts, content support, and escalations

b. Onboard new affiliates: account setup in SliceWP (or our affiliate platform of record), tracking links, custom discount codes, swipe copy, and brand guidelines.

c. Provide affiliates with creative assets, product information, content briefs, and seasonal campaign packets.

d. Build personal rapport with top performers; identify candidates for elevated tiers, exclusivity deals, or paid partnerships

e. Re-engage dormant or underperforming affiliates with targeted campaigns and incentive resets.



3. Program Operations



a. Manage the affiliate platform (SliceWP / equivalent): commission tiers, payout schedules, tracking link integrity, fraud monitoring, and de-duplication of attribution

b. Process and verify affiliate payouts on schedule; resolve disputes quickly.

c. Maintain a clean, segmented affiliate CRM (by tier, niche, performance, content type, platform).

d. Build and run incentive programs: bonus tiers, leaderboards, seasonal contests, product seeding campaigns.

e. Coordinate product seeding shipments to new and prospective affiliates.



4. Performance & Reporting



a. Own KPIs: affiliate-driven revenue, conversion rate by affiliate, EPC (earnings per click), AOV from affiliate traffic, new-affiliate recruitment rate, activation rate, and retention

b. Build and deliver weekly and monthly reporting dashboards on program health and top performers

c. A/B test commission structures, creative briefs, promo codes, and outreach messaging

d. Identify top-performing content formats and creator profiles; codify into recruitment criteria



5. Compliance & Brand Safety (Critical)



a. Enforce strict compliance with our research-use-only product positioning across all affiliate content — no medical claims, no human-consumption claims, no dosing guidance, no before/after imagery implying human use, no disease/treatment language

b. Review and approve affiliate content before posting where required; spot-monitor live content

c. Maintain FTC disclosure compliance across all affiliate posts (#ad, #sponsored, material connection language)

d. Maintain documentation of content guidelines, affiliate agreements, and acknowledgment of compliance terms

e. Flag and escalate any affiliate behavior that creates regulatory or brand risk



6. Cross-Functional Coordination



a. Work with the paid ads team to avoid customer cannibalization between affiliate and direct-response channels

b. Coordinate with customer service on affiliate-coded order issues

c. Partner with the content team on creative assets, swipe files, and brand guideline updates

d. Feed affiliate content performance back into broader marketing strategy



Required Qualifications:



- 2+ years managing an affiliate, influencer, or creator program at an e-commerce brand

- Demonstrated experience recruiting and managing micro-influencers (not just macro/celebrity tier) on Instagram and TikTok

- Hands-on experience with an affiliate platform (SliceWP, Refersion, Impact, ShareASale, GoAffPro, or similar)

- Strong cold-outreach skills — comfortable running high-volume DM and
 campaigns and measuring funnel conversion

- Working knowledge of FTC disclosure rules and creator marketing compliance

- Excellent written communication and relationship-building skills

- Highly organized — strong CRM/spreadsheet/dashboard discipline

- Self-directed; capable of operating without daily oversight in a remote environment



Preferred / Nice to haves:

- Prior experience in supplements, nootropics, peptides, sports nutrition, or fitness e-commerce

- Familiarity with the research peptide / research compound space and its specific compliance posture (research-use-only positioning, no human-consumption claims)

- Knowledge of WordPress / WooCommerce ecosystem

- Experience with influencer sourcing tools (Modash, Heepsy, Upfluence, Grin)

- Experience with creator seeding logistics

- Basic analytics fluency (GA4, Looker Studio, or similar)



What Success Looks Like



30 days: Fully onboarded into our platform, affiliate roster, and compliance framework. Audit of the current affiliate program, complete with a prioritized improvement list. Outreach pipeline live.



60 days: Net-new active affiliates added at a sustained weekly cadence. Updated onboarding flow, creative asset library, and compliance acknowledgment process deployed. Weekly reporting cadence established.



90 days: Measurable lift in affiliate-attributed revenue. Top-performer tier defined and incentivized. Clear month-over-month growth in active-affiliate count and program revenue contribution.



How to Apply



Send the following in your application:



1. Resume or LinkedIn

2. A short note/description (max 200 words) describing an affiliate or influencer program you’ve grown — include numbers

3. A sample cold outreach DM/email you’d send to a 3K-follower fitness micro-influencer recruiting them to our program

4. Your expected base + commission structure



We move fast. Strong candidates will hear back within 5 business days.

title: Cold calling B2B Appointment Setter — AI Receptionists for Service Businesses (Leads Provided → Full-Time)
description:
We build AI receptionists that answer phones 24/7 for service businesses — plumbers, electricians, landscapers, law firms. Real product, live paying clients across Canada and the US.



The role: You cold call business owners from lead lists we provide — no prospecting, no list building, no closing. You get scripts and full product training. Your job is the conversation: get them curious and book them into a demo call with our team. We take it from there.



How it starts: A 1–2 week paid trial, structured as performance-based bonuses — typically $120–$280 per deal that closes from your booked appointments, uncapped, paid weekly. The trial is deliberately performance-heavy: we're looking for someone whose appointments show up and turn into business.



Where it goes: Perform in the trial and this becomes a full-time ongoing role with consistent lead flow.



You:

- Proven B2B phone sales or appointment-setting experience 

-Cold calling experience

- Fluent, confident English; comfortable calling Canadian & US business owners

- Available North American business hours (ET) — from the Philippines this is a night-shift role

- Hungry — you want to be paid for results, not for dialing



We provide: leads, scripts, training, and CRM access.



HOW TO APPLY (required):

1. Describe the highest-volume phone role you've held and how many appointments you set per week.

2. Include a LINK to a voice recording (Vocaroo, Google Drive, or Dropbox) of yourself delivering the opening script below, natural and conversational — like a real call, not a read-through (swap in your own name):



"Hey John? Oh hey John, it's Shawn over at Reign Solutions. I know I'm catching you out of the blue here, but do you mind if I grab 10 seconds? I'll let you know why I called and you can tell me if it's relevant or not.



Appreciate that. Have you heard of Voice AI by chance? Feel free to cut me off if it's not in your wheelhouse.



We work with businesses to help automate their phone calls and appointments using Voice AI. This makes sure no leads are missed, and no potential revenue is missed as well. Would you say your business receives at least 5-10 calls per day?"



Applications without a recording will not be considered.

title: Digital & E-commerce Assistant
description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY



Scriveiner is an award-winning British luxury brand specialising in writing instruments and premium accessories. We serve millions of customers worldwide through major online marketplaces and more than 1,000 retail stores globally.



We are the flagship brand of Infinity Brands, a founder-led, high-growth business building premium consumer brands with global reach.



HOW TO APPLY



Please complete this application form:



ABOUT THE ROLE



We’re looking for a Digital & E-commerce Assistant to help keep our Shopify store running smoothly and support the growth of our online sales.



You’ll work with our Senior Digital & E-commerce Manager on product listings, website updates, campaign support, and performance reporting. You may also provide occasional support with Amazon.



This is a hands-on, junior role for someone organised and detail-minded who enjoys online retail and wants to develop their e-commerce skills.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



1. Shopify store and product content

- Upload and update Shopify products, including titles, descriptions, images, prices, variants, and stock details

- Write and edit product copy, meta titles, and meta descriptions

- Resize and prepare product images to meet brand and platform requirements

- Check the website regularly for broken links, incorrect prices, out-of-stock items, and checkout issues

- Set up promotions, discount codes, collections, and homepage banners for campaigns



2. Amazon support

- Update Amazon listings and catalogue information when needed

- Help monitor listing performance, reviews, and compliance



3. Digital marketing support

- Help prepare and schedule
 campaigns and automated flows

- Coordinate campaign assets with designers, photographers, and agencies

- Support campaigns across other digital channels as needed



4. Reporting and operations

- Prepare weekly sales and traffic reports using Shopify analytics and Google Analytics 4

- Track key measures such as conversion rate, average order value, traffic sources, and
 performance

- Coordinate with customer service and warehouse teams about orders, returns, and stock issues



WHAT YOU'LL NEED



These are essential requirements. Please apply only if you have practical, hands-on experience with all three:

- Shopify, including product uploads, collections, discounts, and website content

- Amazon Seller Central, including listing or catalogue management

- Google Analytics 4, including checking traffic or sales data and preparing reports



You should also have:

- 1–2 years of experience in e-commerce or online retail

- Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, including filters, lookups, and pivot tables

- Clear, accurate writing and close attention to detail

- The ability to organise your own work, meet deadlines, and work independently from home

- Basic HTML skills for simple text formatting

- A practical, proactive approach to solving problems



HELPFUL EXPERIENCE



These are an advantage, but they are not required:

- Klaviyo

- Meta Ads Manager

- Google Ads

- Matrixify for bulk product edits or product management



HOW TO APPLY



Please complete this application form:



You’ll be asked to provide your CV and a short video introduction. In your video, please briefly cover:

1. Your e-commerce or online retail experience

2. One example of a product listing or Shopify store update you handled yourself

3. Your experience using Amazon Seller Central

4. How you have used GA4 to check traffic or sales and report what you found

5. Short note on an online store you admire (and one thing you'd improve)

6. Why this role interests you



Please describe your own work and be specific about what you did. You do not need to share confidential company information or account access. Applications without a CV, video introduction, or hands-on experience with Shopify, Amazon Seller Central, and GA4 will not be considered.



HIRING STAGES

description:
We run two Australian ecommerce brands. One sells leather belts, the other sells sleep products. Both are on Shopify and Klaviyo. We are looking for one person to take over
 for both.



Right now I plan every campaign myself and I do not have time for it anymore. I want someone who can own it.



WHAT YOU WOULD DO



- Build the monthly campaign calendar for both brands

- Write the copy. Subject lines, preview text, body, CTAs

- Brief our designer on what each
 needs

- Build and schedule everything in Klaviyo

- Run proper A/B tests on our flows and report what you find



Design is handled by someone else, so you do not need to design. You need to be able to tell them what to make.



About 3
s a week per brand, so roughly 26 a month.



WHAT WE NEED



- Real Klaviyo experience. Not "I have used it", actually run an account.

- We want the person who did the work, not the person who managed someone else doing it. You will be writing and building this yourself.

- You can write. This is a copywriting job as much as a strategy job.

- Ecommerce, ideally DTC. Not B2B, not agency-of-record work.

- Excellent written English. Our customers are Australian.

- You can work with our brand rules. Both brands have things we cannot say for legal reasons and you need to respect that without being reminded.



WHAT WE ARE NOT AFTER



Someone who thinks A/B testing means swapping subject lines. We want tests that actually change the outcome.



HOURS



Around 12 to 15 hours per week to start. This can grow into more, including campaign and ads work, if it goes well.



HOW TO APPLY



Answer all five below. Applications that skip any of these get deleted.



1. Tell me about one Klaviyo account you have run. I want:



- Roughly how big the list was

- What percentage of revenue came from

- Which flows were live

- Was this in-house, through an agency, or direct with the client?

- If it was an agency or a team, what was YOUR specific part? Did you plan it, write it, build it, or all three?



Numbers, not adjectives. If you cannot remember the numbers, say so rather than guessing.



2. Our flows are already built and running. What would be the first thing you tested, and why that one first?



3. Write me a subject line, preview text and full
. The product is mouth tape for better sleep, $39 for a month's supply, sold to Australian women aged 30 to 55. The
 is going to people who bought once about three weeks ago and have not reordered.



4. What is one
 campaign you sent that did not work? What happened, and what did you change?



5. Start your application with the word PUMPKIN so I know you read this properly.

description:
Bookkeeper – Financial Reconciliation & Contractor Compliance Verification





MUST HAVE EXPERIENCE!! ATTENTION TO DETAIL AND EXTREME ACCURACY IS A MUST! NIGHT SHIFT YOUR TIME, , EST USA DAY TIME ZONE.  



Company: Nile Language Services LLC

Location: Remote

Position Type: Independent Contractor / Full Time

Industry: Language Services & Interpretation



About Nile Language Services



Nile Language Services LLC is a growing language services company providing professional interpretation and translation services across the United States. We serve healthcare organizations, legal professionals, government agencies, and businesses.



We are seeking an experienced, highly organized, and detail-oriented Bookkeeper to oversee financial reconciliation, verify interpreter payments, and conduct an additional review of contractor compliance documentation through Adobe Acrobat and our internal systems.



The ideal candidate must demonstrate exceptional accuracy, accountability, confidentiality, and the ability to identify and resolve discrepancies.



Key Responsibilities



1. Bookkeeping & Financial Management



Maintain accurate financial records using QuickBooks Online.



Reconcile bank transactions, invoices, deposits, and payments.



Monitor accounts payable and accounts receivable.



Track outstanding client invoices and overdue balances.



Review financial transactions for accuracy and proper categorization.



Prepare weekly and monthly financial reports.



Maintain organized records for tax preparation and coordinate with tax professionals as needed.



2. Interpreter Payment Verification & Reconciliation



Independently review interpreter payments before final management approval.



Cross-reference completed assignments in Boostlingo against payment records in Gusto.



Verify approved contractor rates, appointment duration, minimum hours, mileage, and authorized expenses.



Identify duplicate payments, incorrect rates, and discrepancies.



Review interpreter payment history to prevent overpayments.



Confirm that payments correspond to authorized assignments and applicable cancellation policies.



Report financial discrepancies to management.



3. Client Payment Reconciliation



Verify that client payments are accurately recorded in QuickBooks.



Match incoming payments to the appropriate client invoices.



Identify outstanding, partially paid, or incorrectly applied payments.



Reconcile bank deposits with payment records.



Maintain accurate accounts receivable reports.



Coordinate with the operations team to resolve discrepancies.



4. Adobe Acrobat & Contractor Document Verification



Access and review contractor documentation submitted through Adobe Acrobat and approved company systems.



Verify that all required forms have been completed and signed.



Confirm that W-9 forms and independent contractor agreements are on file.



Review interpreter credentials, certifications, and other required compliance documents.



Monitor document expiration dates and identify missing or incomplete records.



Cross-reference Adobe submissions against active interpreter profiles.



Maintain an updated compliance checklist for each contractor.



Notify management immediately of missing or questionable documentation.



Ensure required documentation is reviewed before an interpreter is approved for assignments.



5. Contractor Legal Status & Work Authorization Compliance



Conduct administrative checks of documentation required under Nile Language Services' contractor onboarding policies.



Verify that contractors have submitted the required identity, tax, and eligibility-related information applicable to their engagement.



Flag inconsistent, incomplete, or potentially invalid documentation for management review.



Coordinate with management and qualified legal professionals when work authorization, immigration, or contractor classification questions arise.



Maintain confidential records of completed compliance checks.



Follow applicable federal and state requirements and company-approved procedures.



Ensure that unresolved compliance concerns are escalated before contractor approval.



Important: A W-9, Social Security number, EIN, or background check alone does not establish immigration status or authorization to work in the United States. The bookkeeper will not independently determine immigration status, request unnecessary immigration documents, or perform legal assessments. Any verification process must be established with qualified legal guidance and applied consistently without discrimination.



6. Quality Assurance & Internal Controls



Perform an additional independent review of financial and contractor documentation records.



Identify recurring errors and recommend improvements.



Maintain detailed records of discrepancies and corrective actions.



Communicate issues promptly to management.



Protect confidential financial, personal, and contractor information.



Follow company-approved access controls and security procedures.



Refrain from authorizing payments or modifying banking information without express management approval.



Required Qualifications



Proven bookkeeping or accounting experience.



Strong proficiency in QuickBooks Online.



Experience with bank reconciliation and payment verification.



Familiarity with Adobe Acrobat, including reviewing electronically signed documents.



Knowledge of W-9 forms, 1099 contractor documentation, and recordkeeping.



Strong attention to detail and ability to identify discrepancies.



Excellent organizational and communication skills.



Ability to handle confidential information securely.



Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.



Preferred Qualifications



Experience with Gusto.



Experience with Boostlingo or similar scheduling systems.



Background in contractor onboarding and document compliance.



Familiarity with U.S. independent contractor compliance requirements.



Experience working with staffing agencies, healthcare organizations, or language service providers.



Position Expectations



We are seeking a proactive professional who will not simply enter information but will actively verify its accuracy.

Compensation & Schedule

title: Content Strategist - SEO, Local SEO & AI Search
description:
How to Apply — IMPORTANT: To be considered for this position, you must complete the application form linked at the bottom of this job description. Applications submitted only through Onlinejobs.ph will not be reviewed.

**Please note there are no freelancer positions available within our company.

We ask that you do not continue filling out this form if you are only available as a freelancer or are only available part-time.



About Agency Hero



Agency Hero is a digital marketing company specializing in white-label SEO and WordPress services for agencies. We work behind the scenes as an extension of our agency partners' teams, helping businesses improve organic and local search visibility through SEO strategy, content, technical optimization, Local SEO, and emerging AI search strategies.

We are looking for an experienced Content Strategist to join our SEO team. This role requires strong experience developing content strategies for local and service-area businesses, as well as broader organic SEO campaigns.



This is not primarily a content writing position. We need someone who can analyze websites, local and organic search opportunities, competitors, geographic markets, search intent, and SEO data to determine what content to create or improve, why it should exist, how it should be structured, and how it fits into the overall SEO strategy.



What You'll Do

-As a Content Strategist, you will develop and improve SEO content strategies across client websites, with a significant focus on Local SEO and service-area businesses.

-Develop SEO-driven content strategies for local, service-area, regional, and broader organic campaigns.

Perform keyword research and search-intent analysis, including local and geographic search intent.

-Analyze local SERPs, organic competitors, geographic competitors, and content gaps.

Identify new content opportunities based on services, locations, search demand, competitors, and business priorities.

-Determine when service pages, city/location pages, service-area pages, supporting informational content, and other page types should be created.

-Develop service-to-location content strategies without creating unnecessary, thin, duplicative, or doorway-style pages.

-Audit existing website content and identify pages that should be improved, consolidated, expanded, redirected, or removed.

-Develop topic clusters and supporting content designed to strengthen topical and local authority.

-Map keywords, services, topics, locations, and search intent to appropriate pages.

-Plan website content architecture, including service, location, service-area, and supporting content relationships.

-Develop internal linking strategies that strengthen priority service and location pages.

-Identify and prevent keyword, topic, service, and location cannibalization.

-Create detailed content briefs for writers.

-Analyze competitor websites and SERPs to understand what is required to compete in specific markets.

-Review content for SEO effectiveness, quality, relevance, search intent, local relevance, and publication readiness.

-Consider how website content supports broader local visibility, including Google Business Profile and Map Pack performance.

-Work with other members of our SEO, Local SEO, technical, and content teams.

-Use AI tools to improve research, analysis, strategy development, and workflow efficiency.

-Help develop strategies for traditional Google Search, local search, Google AI experiences, and emerging AI-driven search platforms.



Required Experience

We are looking for candidates with demonstrated professional experience in:



-SEO content strategy.

-Local SEO content strategy for local and service-area businesses.

-Developing service-page and location-page strategies.

-Keyword research and local keyword research.

-Search-intent and geographic-intent analysis.

-Competitor and local competitor research.

-Content-gap analysis.

-Content auditing and optimization.

-Developing content plans and detailed briefs.

-On-page SEO.

-Internal linking.

-Using SEO data to make content decisions.

-Professional content writing and editing experience, with the ability to produce, improve, and evaluate publication-ready SEO content.

-Working with AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, or similar platforms in professional SEO or content workflows.



This is a full-time employee position, not a freelance or contract role. Candidates should have significant professional experience working for or within a digital marketing agency, ideally supporting multiple client accounts and working within established SEO, content, and quality-control processes.



Local SEO Knowledge

Candidates should have strong working knowledge of:



-Local search intent and geographic keyword targeting.

-Service-page strategy.

-City and location-page strategy.

-Service-area business SEO.

-Local content architecture and service-to-location relationships.

-Local competitor and SERP analysis.

-Determining when location-specific pages are justified by search intent and business needs.

-Avoiding thin, duplicate, templated, or doorway-style local pages.

-Local keyword and content cannibalization.

-Internal linking for service and location pages.

-Building topical relevance around priority services and markets.

-The relationship between website content, Google Business Profile, organic local results, and Map Pack visibility.

-Multi-location and multi-market content considerations.



Advanced SEO Skills

Strong candidates should also understand:



-Topical authority and topic clustering.

-Content architecture.

-Keyword, entity, and topic mapping.

-E-E-A-T principles.

-YMYL considerations.

-Search intent.

-Content cannibalization.

-Internal linking strategy.

-Competitor analysis.

-SEO content auditing.

-Content prioritization.

-Google Search Console data.

-Modern search behavior and the evolving relationship between traditional SEO, Local SEO, and AI search.



Experience with tools such as Ahrefs, Semrush, Google Search Console, Screaming Frog, and Local SEO/rank-tracking tools is valuable.



AI & Claude Experience

AI is an important part of how our team works. We are particularly interested in candidates who know how to use AI for more than simply generating content.

You should be comfortable using AI to assist with:



-Research and analysis.

-Local and organic content-gap identification.

-Competitor and SERP analysis.

-Content strategy and prioritization.

-Service and location content planning.

-Content briefs.

-SEO analysis.

-Reviewing and improving existing content.

-Identifying entity, topic, and question-coverage opportunities.

-Developing repeatable workflows.



Experience using Claude Projects, Claude Skills, custom GPTs, or other structured/reusable AI workflows is a strong advantage but is not required.



We can teach our specific systems to someone with excellent SEO/content strategy skills who can learn sophisticated AI workflows.



AI Search Visibility

We also want this person to understand how search is evolving beyond traditional organic rankings.



The strategist should be able to consider how content can improve visibility across Google AI experiences and AI-driven platforms such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Microsoft Copilot.



This includes thinking about entity clarity, topical coverage, question coverage, authoritative supporting content, and how local businesses and their services, locations, and expertise are represented across the web.



AI search knowledge is important, but it does not replace strong traditional and Local SEO fundamentals.



What We're Looking For

We want someone who:



-Thinks strategically rather than simply completing tasks.

-Has strong Local SEO instincts as well as broader organic SEO knowledge.

-Can determine whether a local content opportunity actually deserves a dedicated page.

-Can explain the reasoning behind recommendations.

-Has strong professional content writing and editing experience and can recognize excellent versus mediocre content.

-Can independently improve content to a publication-ready standard when needed.

-Is highly analytical.

-Has strong attention to detail.

-Can work independently.

-Follows instructions carefully.

-Communicates clearly.

-Is comfortable learning new technology and workflows.

-Understands that AI should enhance strategic thinking rather than replace it.

-Can identify opportunities rather than waiting to be told exactly what to do.



Position Details

Position: Content Strategist - SEO, Local SEO & AI Search

Schedule: Full-Time

Hours: 8:00 AM-4:00 PM Eastern Time

Location: Remote - Worldwide

Compensation: Competitive compensation based on experience, demonstrated skill level, and geographic market.



Candidates must be able to consistently work the required Eastern Time schedule.



This is not a freelance or part-time opportunity. We are hiring someone to work full-time as part of our team.



Application Process

Applications submitted through the job platform alone will not be considered.

To apply, you must complete our application form:



The application includes questions about your SEO, Local SEO, digital marketing agency, content strategy, writing/editing, and AI experience and requires a short video introduction.



Candidates who successfully complete the initial application process may be invited to complete a practical assessment based on the actual responsibilities of the position, including Local SEO content strategy, broader SEO strategy, and content writing/editing judgment.



Hiring Process

Application + Video → Initial Review → Practical Assessment → Team Review → Interview → Final Evaluation

We use this process to evaluate practical ability, Local SEO and organic SEO strategy, content writing and editing ability, strategic thinking, communication, attention to detail, and overall fit for the position.



Please do not apply unless you are willing to complete the full application process and can consistently work 8:00 AM-4:00 PM Eastern Time.

title: Head of Accounting Team ($6k-7k/month, PTO, 13th Month)
description:
Director of Client Accounting Services

Location: Remote, any country

Pay: $6,000 to $7,000 USD a month

Schedule: Full time. Core hours 9am to 2pm US Eastern on working days.

Reports to: Senior Director, Operations. Works directly with the owner.



You are the person other accountants bring the problem to. The difference nobody can find. The intercompany balance that will not tie. The client who has run out of patience. You fix it, and then someone above you, who often knows less about it than you do, d
 what happens next. This job gives you the decisions.



About Monterra

Monterra is a US accounting and tax firm. We have served business owners since 1991. Most of our clients own many businesses at once: groups with ten, twenty or more locations, each its own company, with numbers that have to tie across all of them.



Specialists. We have built the firm around owners of many businesses, so you spend your time on hard, interesting books instead of a long tail of one-off files.



Thirty-five years, and growing. New multi-location groups signed with us this fall, and not one client has left us in the past year.

We build our own tools. We wrote our own tax planning software, and we are rebuilding accounting the same way.



Remote by design. The whole firm works remotely. You will not be the one person on a different clock in an office that forgot you exist.



The role

We have more good clients than we have people to serve them, so we are hiring one person to run our whole client accounting department: the team, the standards, the final review and the numbers. There is no partner to wait on. When you see a better way to run it, you have the authority to change it. We are rebuilding the department around automation, and you d
 what gets automated and write the procedure the team follows once it works.



What you will own

The team: workloads, deadlines, coaching, hiring and performance for every accountant, in-house and outsourced

Final technical review of every close and financial statement before it reaches a client

One written method for every recurring task, plus a quality control program with monthly sample checks and an error log

Hours against benchmark and realization for every client, reported to leadership on one page each month

Onboarding each new client to a first clean close, and the client call when something goes wrong

The automation rebuild, starting with bank reconciliation matching, and a second-in-command who can run the department without you



Requirements

We judge what you have done, not how long you did it. You must be able to show us:

A team of accountants you ran for clients, and what changed because you ran it: closes that came in on time and errors that went down

Your record as the final reviewer on other accountants' work: closes and financial statements for multi-entity groups

A bank reconciliation you did yourself in the last twelve months

A procedure you wrote that a team actually follows

An outsourced or remote team you held to a standard, with numbers to prove it

English strong enough to explain a set of financial statements, or a mistake in them, to a US business owner on a live call



Nice to have

Franchise accounting, including 13-period calendars

Thomson Reuters Accounting CS

Accounting work you automated, and the hours it saved

You do not need a degree, a licence, a particular title or a set number of years.



Pay and perks

$6,000 to $7,000 USD a month, paid in US dollars wherever you live

Annual bonus tied to your team's performance.

Work from anywhere. Fully remote, in any country.

Run your own day outside the core hours.

A short line to the top. Your proposals go to the Senior Director, Operations and the owner, and you get an answer.

Your own bench. You choose and develop the person who will be your number two.

Paid time off. Two weeks to start, plus all US holidays and the public holidays where you live.



Your first year

First 30 days: You learn every client and meet every accountant. You start on the bank reconciliations for our largest client group.

By day 90: The buck stops with you on every client close and you run the weekly workload review. Your review standard and onboarding checklists are in use. Your first monthly report is sent.

By month 6: Every recurring task has one written method. Monthly quality checks are running. Our outsourced partner is held to the hours and quality we agreed, with data.

By month 9: You own the department. At least one automated workflow is live under your procedures. Someone on your team can run the department for two weeks while you are away.



How we hire

We do not screen on job titles or count your years. We ask what you did, with numbers, and who can confirm it.

Application. About 35 minutes. Three short accounting tests and questions about your results. No cover letter.

Work test one. A month-end close review, a bank reconciliation and a written procedure, built from the work you would own here. About 2.5 hours.

Work test two. Your first weeks in the seat, in one data pack. About 2.5 hours.

Interview with the owner. We contact your references after the interview, not before.

Every application gets a reply. You will never wait weeks in silence wondering whether anyone read your work.



How to apply

Apply here: 
/dcas-application. There is one seat.

You’ll cull and quality-check photos, manage our video board, coordinate with our editors and videographers, deliver finished photos and videos, and handle client revisions,  making sure every order goes out complete, correct, and on time.

Work days: Tuesday–Sunday (Mondays off)

- Strong attention to detail and a commitment to quality

- Ability to handle multiple tasks and manage time effectively

What we offer:

title: Business Development Specialist
description:
Position Summary

Our company is seeking a driven, energetic, and results-oriented Business Development Specialist to join our growing sales team. This role is ideal for a confident English communicator who thrives on building relationships, creating opportunities, and generating new business.



As the first point of contact with prospective clients, you will be responsible for conducting high-volume outbound prospecting through cold calling, email, and other outreach strategies. You will make approximately 150 outbound cold calls per day while leveraging HubSpot CRM to manage leads, track activity, and nurture prospects.



You will engage directly with CEOs, business owners, executives, and business brokers, introducing our services, identifying business needs, and scheduling qualified appointments for our sales team. Success in this role requires resilience, professionalism, curiosity, and the ability to build trust quickly through meaningful conversations.



Candidates must possess exceptional spoken and written English communication skills. Previous experience in B2B sales is required.



Key Responsibilities

• Conduct approximately 150 outbound cold calls per day to prospective clients.

• Generate new business opportunities through cold calling, email campaigns, and outbound prospecting.

• Engage CEOs, business owners, executives, and brokers in professional, consultative conversations.

• Present HR Partners' services and value proposition compellingly and professionally.

• Identify customer needs, qualify prospects, and schedule high-quality appointments for the sales team.

• Maintain accurate prospect records, call activity, notes, and follow-up tasks within HubSpot CRM.

• Develop and maintain a healthy sales pipeline through consistent daily outreach.

• Follow established sales processes while achieving daily, weekly, and monthly activity goals.

• Collaborate with the sales team to share market insights and improve prospect engagement strategies.

• Represent HR Partners with professionalism, integrity, and a customer-first mindset.



Qualifications

• Experience using HubSpot CRM or similar customer relationship management software is preferred.

• Minimum of 2 years of experience in outbound B2B sales, appointment setting, or business development.

• Demonstrated success in high-volume cold calling and lead generation.

• Excellent verbal and written English communication skills with a clear, professional, and confident speaking voice.

• Ability to confidently communicate with C-suite executives, business owners, and decision-makers.

• Strong relationship-building, active listening, and objection-handling skills.

• Self-motivated, resilient, goal-oriented, and comfortable working in a performance-driven environment.

• Excellent organizational and time management skills with strong attention to detail.

• Experience selling HR outsourcing, payroll, benefits, insurance, or other business services is highly preferred.

• Reliable high-speed internet connection and a professional, distraction-free home office if working remotely.

• Ability to work during United States Eastern Time business hours.



Work Schedule

• Monday through Friday

• 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM Eastern Standard Time (EST)

• This is a full-time position. Candidates must be available to work during EST business hours.



Performance Expectations

• Complete approximately 150 outbound cold calls each business day.

• Consistently meet or exceed daily, weekly, and monthly outbound activity and appointment-setting goals.

• Maintain accurate and timely CRM documentation.

• Deliver a professional and engaging customer experience during every interaction.

• Build and maintain a strong pipeline of qualified business opportunities.

• Contribute to the continued growth of the sales organization through consistent prospecting and relationship building.



What Success Looks Like

The successful business development specialist is energetic, coachable, highly motivated, and enjoys speaking with new people every day. They are comfortable handling objections, persistent without being pushy, and focused on creating opportunities that help the sales team close new business. They embrace accountability, consistently exceed activity goals, and contribute to the company's long-term growth by generating qualified appointments and fostering strong business relationships.
