title: Crypto BD Lead Wanted: Turn DeFi Contacts Into Booked Calls, Get Paid Per Call + Overrides
description:
Part-time: 20 hrs/week | $10/hr base + $100 per appointment you book + overrides and deal bonuses, no cap | Remote | Crypto/DeFi



At target pace this role pays roughly $1,500 to $2,500/month from base and appointment bonuses alone, before any partnership revenue, with no cap on the upside. Base is the floor, not the offer.



𝗔𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗚𝗠𝗜



GonnaMakeIt (GMI) built LP Bonds, a live DeFi liquidity product deployed across 9+ EVM chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, and more).



LP Bonds lock liquidity for 20 years while giving users a tradeable Bond NFT earning
% APR. The liquidity is locked, the user is not: they can sell their Bond NFT anytime. Rewards accrue inside the bond instead of being farmed and dumped.



Our partnership targets: DEXs, token launchpads, L1/L2 blockchain ecosystems, and select token projects with strong strategic fit.



We need someone to build and run a BD engine that consistently puts qualified partnership calls on the founder's calendar.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗿𝗼𝗹𝗲



One job: produce qualified partnership calls that actually happen, every week.



The founder takes the calls and closes. You own everything before that: rep recruiting and management, target selection, qualification, outreach strategy, follow-up, pipeline, booking, call prep, and funnel diagnosis.



This is a player-coach role. You manage commission-based BD reps AND personally do outreach and book calls whenever the team is below target. Meetings, training, recruiting, and spreadsheet work do not count as output. Qualified calls held count as output.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗺𝗲𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗰



Qualified partnership appointments held per week. After ramp: floor 2 personally booked, target 5 team total, strong 6+.



A call counts only when ALL are true: the target passes our qualification standard, the attendee is a decision-maker (or credible sponsor with direct access to one), they explicitly expressed interest in LP Bonds for their org, they know what the call is about, the call happens, a real partnership discussion occurs, and the founder confirms it was qualified.



Does NOT count: no-shows, reschedules until held, calls where they pitch their product to us, generic networking, community mods who can't advance a deal, duplicates, or projects that can't realistically use LP Bonds.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝗼𝘄𝗻



1. Rep performance. Audit the existing rep team immediately. Recruit replacements as needed. Give each rep target accounts, messaging, channels, and weekly numbers. Coach producers, cut non-producers. A rep showing no meaningful pipeline progress after 10 working days gets diagnosed and acted on, not carried for 30.

2. Targeting. At least 80% of the active pipeline is DEXs, launchpads, and L1/L2 ecosystems. Targets are EVM-compatible unless the founder approves an exception. Do not fill the pipeline with projects just because they're easy to reach.

3. Qualification. You run (or audit) our LP Bonds Partner Assessment on every interested project. Score of 5/10+ on our Reach/Health/Access rubric passes to the founder. Before any prospect reaches the founder you confirm: real scale/traction, a genuine LP Bonds fit, a decision-maker in the loop, and explicit interest in LP Bonds for THEM. "We want to explore this for our ecosystem" is interest. "Sounds cool, let's find synergies" is not.

4. Conversion, not volume. Our history shows the exact failure you're hired to prevent: reps sending 40-60 outreaches a week, reporting "interested projects," and producing no decision-maker conversations and no calls. You own the conversion at every stage:



Positive reply → meaningful advancement within 5 business days. That means a decision-maker conversation, a
 group or direct thread with the right person, or a concrete scheduled next step toward a call. If none occurs, the prospect is recycled or closed out of active pipeline. Claimed interest that never advances counts as nothing.



Any opportunity untouched for 5 business days gets a decision: advance, recycle, or close. Nothing sits in "waiting."



"Calendly shared" is not a completed task. No booking within 2 business days means follow-up happens, and the prospect is told to confirm the booking with both you and the rep.



If significant outreach produces no qualified calls, you identify the failure point (targets, contacts, messaging, channel, follow-up, or rep) and launch a new test within 24 hours. The same broken approach never runs for multiple weeks.



5. Pipeline control. One accurate source of truth: target, category, tier, contact and decision-maker status, owner, every touch, stage, next action, deadline, call status. Duplicate outreach prevented. All partner groups remain accessible to GMI even if a rep leaves. All activity is logged in our tracker same day. Unlogged work doesn't exist and doesn't pay.

6. Founder handoff. Before a call goes on the founder's calendar: a short brief covering who they are, why they're qualified, why LP Bonds fit, what interest they expressed, who d
, and the desired outcome. No Calendly shared before the qualification gate is complete.

7. Reporting and escalation. Every Friday YOU post one consolidated report: outreach sent, positive replies, qualified conversations, groups created, calls booked, calls held, conversion at each stage, per-rep results, stalled deals, next week's tests. Exact numbers and names, no narratives. Chasing reps for their numbers is your job, done before Friday, never visible to the founder.



If the week is heading to zero qualified calls, you tell the founder THAT DAY with the likely cause, the numbers, the fix being launched, and when results should show.



Bad news early is rewarded. Bad news buried is a dealbreaker.



𝗧𝗶𝗺𝗲 𝗮𝗹𝗹𝗼𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻



50%+ on outreach, follow-up, and appointment conversion

Up to 25% managing and recruiting reps

Up to 25% research, reporting, and admin



Building internal tools, assigning books, refining meeting formats, and polishing trackers do not count toward anything. If the team is below target, your personal outreach time goes up.



𝗙𝗶𝗿𝘀𝘁 𝟯𝟬 𝗱𝗮𝘆𝘀 (𝗽𝗮𝗶𝗱 𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗮𝗹)



Week 1: full audit of every rep and the current pipeline, clean pipeline and reporting live, personal outreach started.

Day 14: 2+ qualified appointments held. Zero held by Day 14 triggers an immediate role review.

Day 30: 2+ qualified appointments held per week pace, clean pipeline, producing rep core. Target: 3+/week.



Hit the numbers and this grows into a larger BD leadership role with more hours and higher comp as we scale.



𝗖𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗲𝗻𝘀𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻



Base: $10/hr, up to 20 hrs/week



Minimum Requirement: 2 qualified appointments held per week that you personally booked. Your base pay covers these first two. Every additional personally booked appointment pays $100, and every rep-booked appointment pays you the $30 override, starting from the first. The 30-day trial milestones above set the ramp: 2+ held by Day 14, 2+/week pace by Day 30.



$100 for every qualified appointment held that you personally booked beyond your weekly minimum of 2

$30 override for every qualified appointment held that your reps booked



𝗣𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽 𝗿𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗻𝘂𝗲, 𝘁𝘄𝗼 𝗹𝗮𝗻𝗲𝘀:



Partnerships YOU originated: you earn the full rep package.



- Commission: 20% of all upgrade fees generated by the partnership during its first 180 days live.

- Launch Bonus: 3% of the total dollar value of bonds minted through the partnership during its first 180 days live.

- No ceiling on either.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘁𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗹𝗼𝗼𝗸𝘀 𝗹𝗶𝗸𝗲 𝗼𝗻 𝗼𝗻𝗲 𝗽𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽:



- Mints $100,000 and generates $15,000 in upgrade fees: $3,000 + $3,000 = $6,000

- Mints $200,000 and generates $30,000 in upgrade fees: $6,000 + $6,000 = $12,000



Partnerships your REPS originated: you earn a 20% override on everything the rep earns from that partnership, both their 20% commission on upgrade fees and their 3% launch bonus, for the same 180-day window. Paid by GMI on top of their earnings, never deducted from them.



Every partnership has exactly one originator of record in our tracker, so lanes never stack on the same deal.



Additional bonuses possible for exceptional strategic partnerships.



No cap on any of the above. One appointment bonus per call ($100 personal OR $30 override, not both).



Appointment bonuses paid after the call happens and the founder confirms it met the standard.



Base and appointment bonuses paid 50/50 in ETH and $GMI, with the GMI portion on an 18-month vesting schedule. Commission are paid bi-weekly as your 20% share of the $GMI collected in upgrade fees (fully liquid, no vesting), so your cut never depends on GMI price. Launch bonus is 3% of the USD value of bonds at time of mint, paid bi-weekly in ETH at the average ETH price over the 14 day payroll period.



𝗥𝗲𝗾𝘂𝗶𝗿𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘀



- Crypto-native: DEXs, launchpads, liquidity, TVL, ecosystems, no googling required

- Prior crypto BD, partnerships, lead-gen, or appointment-setting experience with calls you personally booked

- Experience managing contractors or reps against numbers, and comfortable cutting non-performers

- Excellent written English, comfortable messaging founders and senior decision-makers

- Organized: CRMs, trackers,
, X, LinkedIn,
, outreach platforms (we use Saleshandy)

- 3+ hrs daily overlap with GMT+7/+8

- Responsive within 10 minutes during your agreed working block unless on a scheduled call



𝗪𝗼𝗿𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘀𝘁𝗮𝗻𝗱𝗮𝗿𝗱𝘀



Outcomes over activity. Calls held over calls promised. Decision-makers over moderators. Explicit interest over vague networking. Exact numbers over narratives. Problems escalated the day they appear. No hiding bad weeks. No perfecting systems that don't produce calls. The founder never manages your reps.



𝗛𝗼𝘄 𝘁𝗼 𝗮𝗽𝗽𝗹𝘆



Applications missing any item are auto-rejected. Send:



1. IMPORTANT: Your subject line must start with BOND OPS.

2. Loom video (2-3 min): who you are, your crypto experience, the most qualified appointments you've personally booked in one month, and how you'd produce 5 qualified GMI partnership calls per week.

3. In writing (3-4 sentences): what a launchpad is and why one would want LP Bonds for its projects.

4. Scenario: "Your reps sent 250 targeted messages in one week, received 18 positive replies, and booked zero qualified calls. What do you inspect, and what do you change in the next 48 hours?"

5. One target for GMI (a DEX, launchpad, or ecosystem): why it's qualified, the exact role you'd contact, the channel, and the personalized first message you'd send.

6. Your
 handle, available hours in GMT+8, and earliest start date.

title: Creative Strategist | Women's Shapewear | 8-Figure DTC Brand
description:
*** URGENT HIRE: START TODAY ***

We review applications today, and the right person starts TODAY/ ASAP.

If you cannot start today, please do not apply.



CREATIVE STRATEGIST (FULL-TIME, REMOTE), JUNIOR PROFILES WELCOME



Read this first.

We are not looking for someone who wants a job. We are looking for someone who is obsessed with ads. Someone who spends hours in the Meta Ad Library, who knows which brands are scaling in the US right now, and who cannot stop asking "why does this ad work?". Someone who wants to learn fast, work hard, and become one of the best creative strategists out there.



If that is you, experience matters less than hunger. We will train you.



About us

We are a direct-to-consumer brand in women's shapewear, doing 8 figures in annual revenue and scaling fast in the US market. Paid social (Meta, TikTok) is the engine of our growth, and creative is what drives it. Q4 is our biggest season, so this hire is urgent: we need someone who can start today, not next week.



We want someone who grows with us for the long term, not a short mission.



What you will do

- Spend time every day in the Meta Ad Library and on TikTok, studying what the big DTC brands are running and scaling in the US right now, and bring us the best ideas every week

- Research our customers: read reviews, comments and surveys, and find the exact words they use

- Turn that research into new angles and hooks that stop the scroll

- Write ad scripts (hook, body, call to action) and clear creative briefs

- Produce ads yourself with our internal video tool and AI tools (image, video, voice-over). Full training provided

- Look at ad results with us, understand why an ad wins or loses, and improve the next one



You will learn the full method: angles, hooks, awareness levels, funnel stages (TOFU, MOFU, BOFU), native ads, statics, UGC and AI video. You work directly with the founder, every day.



Who we are looking for

- You are obsessed with ads. You already use the Meta Ad Library, and you follow what the big brands are doing in the US market

- You can explain why an ad works: the angle, the hook, who it speaks to

- You know the basics of direct response: TOFU, MOFU, BOFU and the awareness levels

- You are hungry. You want to learn, you take feedback well, and you apply it the same day

- Very good written English (you will write scripts and copy for a US audience)

- Comfortable with tools: Canva, CapCut or any editor, ChatGPT or other AI tools

- Organized and reliable: you deliver on time, every time, without being chased

- Full-time availability: 8 hours a day, Monday to Friday, fully committed (no other full-time job)

- Ready to start TODAY

- 18 years old or older, with a bank account in your own name



Nice to have

- Experience in marketing, copywriting, content creation or ad editing, even personal projects

- Experience with AI image or video tools

- Knowledge of the women's apparel, shapewear or beauty market

- French (a real plus, not required)



Senior profiles with real DTC experience are of course welcome too.



What we offer

- USD 700 per month, paid twice a month

- Performance bonuses on top, based on the results of your ads

- Full training on our method and our tools, directly from the founder

- A real seat at the table in a fast-growing brand, and room to grow quickly

- Full-time, long-term, 100% remote



How to apply

This hire is urgent and we will move fast: the right person starts today. We only read applications that answer ALL the points below, in your own words. Answers copied from ChatGPT are easy to spot and will be rejected.



Start your application with the word: HUNGRY-Q4



1. A short introduction: who you are, and why you want this job

2. In your own words, explain:

   - What TOFU, MOFU and BOFU mean, with one example of an ad for each

   - What the 5 levels of awareness are, and how an ad changes from one level to another

3. Go to the Meta Ad Library and find one ad from a brand that is scaling in the US right now (any niche). Send the link or a screenshot, and in 3 to 5 lines: the angle, the hook, the awareness level it targets, and why you think it works

4. Anything you made: ads, scripts, edits, content, an ad breakdown. No experience? Show us something you did on your own

5. Confirm that you can start today



Shortlisted candidates will get a short paid test task and a call the same day.

title: Autodesk Inventor Draftsperson / Parametric Design Specialist
description:
Autodesk Inventor Draftsperson / Parametric Design Specialist



Location: Philippines — work from home

Employment: Full-time

Hours: Monday to Friday, with overlap during Australian business hours

Salary: Based on experience and skills



About Protector Australia



Protector Australia is an Australian manufacturer of fibreglass tanks, pump stations, grease arrestors and stormwater treatment equipment.



We are looking for an experienced Autodesk Inventor draftsperson to join our team remotely. You will prepare detailed drawings for customer projects and help us develop parametric models that make our quoting and drawing processes faster and more consistent.



You will work closely with our Australian team.



What you will do



- Create and update 3D parts and assemblies in Autodesk Inventor.

- Prepare detailed manufacturing and fabrication drawings.

- Produce general arrangement, customer approval and installation drawings.

- Develop parametric models that can be adjusted for different sizes and project requirements.

- Write and update Inventor iLogic rules to automate models and drawings.

- Prepare parts lists and bills of materials.

- Manage drawing revisions and keep files organised.

- Work from sketches, marked-up drawings, specifications and instructions from the Australian team.

- Check drawings carefully before submitting them for review.



Our first parametric drawing priority is our HydroVault fibreglass storage tank range. The aim is to develop a model that can be configured for different tank sizes and connection arrangements, with the relevant drawings generated from it.



Over time, we want to develop similar models and drawing packs for other Protector products.



Skills and experience



Essential:



- Strong, practical experience using Autodesk Inventor for 3D parts, assemblies and 2D drawings.

- Experience preparing detailed drawings for manufacturing or fabrication.

- Experience building and modifying parametric models using dimensions, constraints and parameters.

- Ability to read and work from engineering drawings and sketches.

- Strong attention to detail and the ability to check your own work.

- Good written and spoken English.

- Reliable internet and a computer suitable for running Inventor.



Highly regarded:



- Experience writing Inventor iLogic rules and automating drawings or product configurations.

- Experience with Autodesk Vault.

- Experience with tanks, piping, steel or fibreglass fabrication, pump stations or similar equipment.

- Experience preparing bills of materials.

- Experience working with Australian manufacturing or engineering companies.

- Understanding of how configurable models can support a quoting or CPQ system.



We will provide training on Protector’s products and drawing requirements. All project drawings and engineering decisions will be reviewed by the Protector team.



How to apply



Please start your application with the word HYDROVAULT and answer the following:



1. How many years have you used Autodesk Inventor, and which version are you currently using?

2. Describe a parametric model you have built. What could be changed, and how did the model update?

3. Have you written iLogic rules yourself? If yes, please give an example of what you automated.

4. What types of manufacturing or fabrication drawings have you prepared?

5. Have you used Autodesk Vault?

6. Please provide two or three examples of drawings or models you personally completed. If possible, include a parametric or automated example.

7. Do you have access to a valid Inventor licence, or would you need one provided?

8. What is your expected hourly or monthly rate in USD, and when could you start?

9. Would you be willing to complete a paid practical drawing trial?



We are looking for someone who enjoys producing accurate drawings, solving problems and building systems that save time. There is an opportunity for ongoing work as we expand our product and drawing automation.

title: Real Estate Listing Officer / Customer Service
description:
Summary

Position Overview



The Property Listing Officer is responsible for securing, documenting, verifying, managing, marketing, and optimizing all property listings (individual & corporate).



This role ensures all listings are fully compliant with Qatar’s real estate regulations, have signed Marketing Agreements (MA), complete information, verified availability, and are high-performing with a 100% scoring standard.



Additionally, the officer contributes to lead generation, identifying potential clients and opportunities from listings, inquiries, and market research. All new listings must be published within 24–48 hours of receiving complete documentation and approvals.



Key Responsibilities

1. Regulatory Compliance & MA Control

- Ensure all listings comply with Qatar’s real estate laws and regulations before posting.

- Ensure 100% of listings have a signed Marketing Agreement (MA) (individual & corporate).

- Track MA expiry and renew in advance.

- Maintain all required documents: ID, Title Deed, NOC if required.

- Maintain digital and physical records of all signed agreements.

- Do not activate or post any listing without full compliance and documentation.



2. Listing Creation & Information Accuracy

- Create complete listings in CRM with accurate property details, pricing, layout, and availability.

- Ensure all listings meet the company’s 100% quality standard before posting.

- Post all new listings within 24–48 hours of receiving complete documentation and approval.

- Add Property Finder (PF) links into CRM for tracking.

- Update listing status immediately when availability changes.

- Remove expired, inactive, or non-compliant listings.



3. Photoshoot Scheduling & Quality Control

- Schedule and coordinate professional photoshoots for new listings.

- Ensure property is ready before shoot.

- Verify high-quality photos/videos match the actual property.

- Upload approved visuals to CRM, portals, and social media.



4. Listing Marketing & Social Media

- Post listings on CRM, property portals, and social media platforms within 24–48 hours.

- Coordinate with marketing team to ensure timely and consistent posting.

- Maintain brand consistency across all listing presentations.

- Prioritize exclusive and high-performing listings.



5. Availability Coordination

- Confirm availability before publishing:

- Individual listings → coordinate with agents

- Corporate listings → coordinate with the developers

- Conduct regular availability checks to maintain accurate inventory.



6. Market Research, Reporting & Lead Generation

- Conduct ongoing market research on pricing, competition, and trends.

- Prepare periodic market reports.

- Identify potential clients and leads from listings, inquiries, and market insights.

- Provide recommendations for pricing adjustments and lead follow-ups.

- Maintain weekly listing inventory and performance reports.



7. Other Responsibilities

- Answer the client's inquiries regarding a property and assign it to the agent

- Perform any listing-related tasks as directed by management.

- Carry out additional duties as required by business priorities and operational needs.

- Assist in process improvements to streamline listing management, marketing, and lead generation.



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

- 100% of listings posted with signed MA

- All new listings published within 24–48 hours

- 0 non-compliant listings published

- Listing accuracy rate / 100% scoring standard

- Photoshoot scheduling turnaround time

- Availability accuracy rate

- Monthly new listings secured

- Social media posting consistency

- Leads generated from listings and market research

- Market report submission consistency

- Calls answered within 5 minutes and have provided accurate info



Core Competencies

- Regulatory compliance & documentation control

- Attention to detail & process-driven mindset

- CRM & portal proficiency

- Communication & coordination skills

- Lead generation & client prospecting ability

- Accountability, integrity, and flexibility

description:
We're a small digital marketing company working with e-commerce brands across Europe. We're hiring one person for customer support, and we want them to stay for years.



THE ROLE

You'll be the person our clients talk to. You'll answer them on 
 and
, solve their problems or get them solved, and keep our dashboards and spreadsheets up to date. This is a customer support role, and it stays one. Support is the core of the job, not a phase you pass through.



Small teams grow. If we grow and you prove yourself, there may be room later to take on more: owning processes, handling the hardest cases, maybe guiding new people. We're not promising a title. We're promising that good work here gets seen and rewarded.



HOURS (Amsterdam time)

Shift A: 08:00–16:00 (= 15:00–23:00 PH time)

Shift B: 16:00–00:00 (= 23:00–07:00 PH time)

3–5 days a week to start, building to full-time.

(PH times are for Nov–Mar. From late March they shift 1 hour earlier.)



You'll need a laptop, stable internet, and a quiet place to work. A lot of the work can be done from your phone, but not all of it.



WHAT WE CARE ABOUT

We can teach you our tools and systems. We can't teach attitude. We're looking for:

- Ownership. When something goes wrong, you fix it or flag it. You don't wait to be told.

- Reliability. You do what you say, on time, without anyone chasing you.

- You actually care about helping people. Clients can tell when you don't.

- You stay calm and respectful when a client is frustrated.

- You want to get better every month, and you take feedback without getting defensive.

- Good written English. You'll be writing to European business owners every day, so this one isn't optional.



Nice to have: experience in e-commerce or customer support, or using AI tools like ChatGPT or Claude to work faster.



HOW TO APPLY (READ CAREFULLY)

Applications without a Loom video will not be reviewed. No exceptions.



1. Record a Loom video (
, it's free) of 3–5 minutes. Keep your camera on. Don't read from a script; we want to see you, not a speech. Answer these:

   - Who are you, and what drives you outside of work?

   - Tell us about a time you did more than you were asked, when nobody was checking. What happened?

   - Tell us about a real mistake you made at work. What did you do next?

   - A client messages you angry about something that isn't your fault. What do you do?

   - Why customer support, and why a long-term role in a small company?



2. Send us a message that starts with the word "ANCHOR". Include:

   - Your Loom link (check that it's set to public/viewable. If we can't open it, we skip it.)

   - Which shift you want: A, B, or both

   - When you could start



That's all. No cover letter, no CV attachment needed at this stage.

Application form:



Role Overview



Candidates with strong, verifiable operations or EA experience, ideally from a trades or construction business, and demonstrable SOP-building skills will be prioritised for this role.



An electrical business needs a self-directed, operations-first VA to take ownership of business administration, job management and SOP documentation. The role is operations and administration-led, not marketing-led — social media and website work remain part of the role, but at a scheduling and execution level, with content strategy handled by an external specialist. This is a strong, self-directed operator role: both directors want someone who takes a task, owns it completely, and delivers without needing to be followed up — someone who pushes back, asks good questions, and suggests a better way when they see one.



The role starts at 20 hours per week (4 hours per day, Monday to Friday), with the expectation this grows to full-time reasonably quickly as more tasks are handed over. A broader goal is a fully documented, less founder-dependent business that could run — or be sold — without day-to-day founder involvement by the end of 2027.



What You’ll Own



Operations, Administration & SOP-Building (Primary Focus)

Process Documentation

Store and link all SOPs in Asana, accessible via the mobile app so field-based staff can reference them

Set a quarterly SOP review cadence to keep documentation accurate as the business evolves



 & Customer Communication

Support customer communication throughout the job lifecycle, from initial enquiry through to job completion and follow-up

Manage customer comms within the job platform where possible



Social Media & Website (Scheduling-Level, Not Strategist-Level)

 report covering tasks completed, work in progress, and items requiring attention or approval

Experience with job management, CRM or trades platforms (Simpro, ServiceM8, Tradify or WunderBuild experience is highly transferable)

, Teams video and associated tools

AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT): genuine, proactive curiosity, not just baseline familiarity — actively pushes their own use of these tools rather than waiting to be shown

Instagram and
 scheduling and 
 via Meta Business Suite

LinkedIn page-building experience from a low base

Communication & Independence

title: Product Sourcing & Research Specialist (Oman & GCC Shipping)
description:
Hiring: Product Sourcing & Research Specialist (Oman & GCC Shipping)



Work Location: Remote



Employment Type: Project-Based / Task-Based



Target Market: Oman, with potential future expansion into GCC countries.



Sourcing Markets: Worldwide, including China, South Korea, Thailand, Vietnam, the UAE, and other countries offering reliable products and competitive sourcing opportunities.



About the Role



We are looking for an experienced Product Sourcing & Research Specialist to support our e-commerce businesses based in Muscat, Oman.



We need someone with proven hands-on experience in discovering commercially viable products, researching market demand, identifying reliable suppliers and manufacturers, negotiating competitive prices, and coordinating sourcing activities until products arrive in Muscat.



We are not looking for someone who simply collects product links or performs basic online research.



We need a sourcing professional who understands market competition, product profitability, supplier verification, international purchasing, and logistics.



Our goal is to find high-quality, authentic products with competitive sourcing costs, strong market potential, and healthy profit margins.



Product Categories



Our sourcing projects focus on the following categories:



1. Skincare



* Serums, moisturizers, and skincare creams.

* Facial and body skincare products.

* Established and reputable skincare brands.



2. Personal Care



* Body care and personal hygiene products.

* Men’s and women’s daily personal care products.

* Specialized personal care products.



3. Intimate & Sexual Wellness



* Men’s and women’s intimate health and wellness products.

* Sexual wellness and performance-related products.

* Men’s delay sprays, creams, and gels.

* Other intimate care and sexual wellness products.



4. Other Consumer Products



* Additional product categories based on market opportunities and business requirements.



Current Priority: Sourcing existing, market-ready products from reliable brands and verified suppliers, particularly in men’s intimate and sexual wellness.



We are not currently focusing on developing Private Label products, although this may be considered in future projects.



Initial Order Quantities & MOQ



We are currently testing products before committing to larger inventory purchases.



* Initial trial orders will typically range from 10 to 20 units per product (SKU), with a maximum of 20 units.

* Suppliers must be willing to accommodate small orders (Low MOQ).

* We are not interested in purchasing large quantities at this stage.

* Competitive pricing is essential, even for small trial orders.

* Suppliers must be able to provide genuine, high-quality products.

* Larger orders may be considered based on actual sales performance and market demand.



The successful candidate must be able to identify suppliers offering small quantities without making the total sourcing and shipping costs commercially unfeasible.



Key Responsibilities



1. Product Research & Market Analysis



* Identify products with strong commercial potential.

* Research market demand in Oman and GCC countries.

* Analyze competing products, retail prices, and market positioning.

* Review product quality, brand reputation, and customer feedback.

* Identify products with potential for healthy profit margins.

* Recommend products based on actual market research and supporting evidence.

* Evaluate potential commercial risks before recommending purchases.



2. Supplier & Manufacturer Sourcing



* Find reliable manufacturers, wholesalers, distributors, and authorized suppliers.

* Research sourcing opportunities across international markets.

* Contact suppliers directly to obtain quotations and product information.

* Verify supplier legitimacy, business credentials, and product authenticity.

* Compare supplier pricing, product quality, availability, and MOQ requirements.

* Negotiate competitive prices and favorable purchasing conditions.

* Identify suppliers willing to accommodate small trial orders.

* Verify product ingredients, certificates, expiry dates, and documentation where applicable.



3. Cost Analysis & Profitability



* Calculate product purchasing costs.

* Estimate international shipping costs.

* Identify applicable customs duties, taxes, and additional expenses.

* Calculate the total landed cost of products delivered to Muscat, Oman.

* Compare landed costs with competitor retail prices.

* Assess potential profit margins and overall commercial feasibility.

* Present clear cost comparisons and sourcing recommendations.



Our priority is commercial profitability, not simply finding the lowest purchase price.



4. International Shipping & Logistics



* Identify reliable and cost-effective freight and shipping providers.

* Coordinate with suppliers and logistics companies.

* Research shipping options from different countries to Oman.

* Check relevant import requirements, shipping restrictions, and necessary documents.

* Identify products requiring special certifications, permits, or regulatory approvals.

* Flag any products that may not be eligible for import or sale in Oman.

* Coordinate approved orders and monitor preparation, dispatch, and delivery.

* Follow up with suppliers and freight providers until products arrive in Muscat.

* Help resolve sourcing, documentation, and shipping issues.



Experience dealing with international freight companies and GCC shipping requirements is highly preferred.



5. Research Reports & Project Management



* Prepare structured product research reports.

* Provide product links, supplier contact details, and quotations.

* Compare available sourcing options.

* Present product costs, estimated shipping expenses, and landed costs.

* Explain the advantages, disadvantages, and risks of each recommendation.

* Provide clear updates on progress, challenges, and pending tasks.

* Organize assigned work and update progress through Asana.



Research must be accurate, transparent, and supported by verifiable information.



Required Qualifications



* 2–5+ years of proven experience in Product Sourcing, Product Research, or Procurement.

* Hands-on experience working with suppliers, distributors, and manufacturers.

* Strong product research and market analysis skills.

* Experience negotiating supplier prices and purchasing terms.

* Ability to verify supplier credibility and product authenticity.

* Understanding of MOQ, FOB, EXW, Incoterms, and landed-cost calculations.

* Knowledge of international purchasing, shipping, and logistics.

* Ability to find suppliers accepting small trial orders.

* Strong English communication skills.

* Ability to work independently and manage assigned projects.

* Good organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

* Professional communication, reliability, and attention to detail.



Preferred Experience



Candidates with the following qualifications will have an advantage:



* Experience sourcing products for businesses operating in Oman or GCC countries.

* Experience shipping goods from China, South Korea, or other Asian countries.

* Experience sourcing skincare, personal care, intimate health, or sexual wellness products.

* Familiarity with products requiring special import permits or regulatory compliance.

* Existing professional relationships with reliable suppliers or freight companies.

* Experience handling small-order sourcing and international sample shipments.

* A proven track record of identifying commercially successful products.



Work Arrangement



* Fully remote.

* Project-based and task-based collaboration.

* No fixed daily working schedule required.

* Not a full-time position at this stage.

* Tasks, responsibilities, and expected deliverables will be clearly defined.

* Asana will be used for task management and progress tracking.

* Performance will be evaluated based on research quality, supplier reliability, competitive pricing, communication, and actual results.



We are looking for a reliable professional who is interested in building a long-term working relationship as our business grows.



How to Apply



Apply directly through WhatsApp:




Please follow these application instructions:



1. Start your WhatsApp message with:



Apply – Product Sourcing



2. Include the link to the job posting you are applying for.



3. Answer all the following questions:



1. How many years of experience do you have in product sourcing and research?

2. Which countries or markets have you sourced products from?

3. Have you previously sourced or shipped products to Oman or other GCC countries? Please explain your experience.

4. Which product categories are you most experienced in?

5. Have you worked with suppliers accepting small trial orders of 10–20 units per product?

6. Have you managed a complete sourcing process, from product research and supplier selection to shipping or delivery?

7. Can you share a real example of a previous sourcing project, including the product category, sourcing country, challenges, and results?



Important:



* Applications must be sent through WhatsApp.

* Start your message with “Apply – Product Sourcing”.

* Include the link to the job advertisement.

* Answer all seven questions clearly.

* A CV is not required at this initial stage.

* Applications without the requested information may not be considered.



We value proven experience, practical sourcing skills, independent problem-solving, transparency, and measurable results.



We are looking for someone who can identify real commercial opportunities and deliver reliable sourcing solutions, not simply conduct basic online searches.

title: Executive Assistant to the CEO | Strategic Partner Role | $2,000 to $3,000/mo
description:
Job Title: Executive Assistant to the CEO | Strategic Partner Role | $2,000 to $3,000/mo



Job Description:

Your Next Boss Wants You to Tell Him When He Is Wrong.

A U.S. real estate CEO is looking for the sharpest executive assistant in the Philippines. Not an order-taker. A strategic partner who anticipates problems, breaks down barriers and makes him better.

Full-time | Remote | 8:15am to 5:15pm US Central Time | $2,000 to $3,000 USD/month

Read this before you apply: most applicants will not pass our tests.

 That is on purpose. We are looking for one A+ player. If you are that person, you will read the next few lines and feel relieved that someone finally said it.

Who you are

 You are the smartest person in most rooms you work in. You are quick, highly organized, and a little bored by jobs that never ask enough of you. You have been the one who sees the problem coming and quietly fixes it before anyone else notices. You want a boss who can keep up with you, and a place where that is valued.

Who he is

 Our CEO is a 20-year real estate broker and investor who has been involved in nearly 2,000 transactions. He runs a growing U.S. real estate and lending group. He has more ideas, projects and
 than one person can handle. His time is the most valuable asset in the company, and too much of it goes to things that should never reach him.

What you will do

Take over his inbox. You read everything and handle what you can. Over time you reply in his voice, and he sees only what truly needs him.

Run his calendar and travel. Protected, prepared, and exactly right.

Turn one-line ideas into finished results. He hands you a sentence. You ask sharp questions, research it and bring back the answer.

Close the loose ends. Bills, follow-ups, documents and requests. Tracked until done.

Build the systems that prevent problems. You see what could go wrong and put structure in place first. You break down the barriers that eat his time.

The part most job posts leave out

 You will be asked to tell the CEO what he missed, what is wrong and where he should rethink. We do not want a complainer, and we do not want a yes-person. We want a strategic thinking partner who pushes back with a better idea and makes the work stronger. If you can do that, you will thrive here. If not, this is not the seat for you.

Who thrives here

You are wicked smart. You learn fast and connect dots without being walked through them.

You communicate excellently. You will write as the CEO, so your written English must be flawless.

You ask great questions. You read, you are curious, and your insight earns trust.

You do what you say you will do. Every time.

You have a history of high achievement at work and outside it. We want to know what you have stuck with and gotten great at.

You value relationships and you are people smart. You hear what someone is not saying.

You are a team player on a small team where your work is seen.

You want to be challenged and become the best version of yourself.

Your last boss would still call you for advice.

Our culture

 We hire and promote on five values: Credibility, High Achievement, Intellect, Relationships and People Smart. These are not wall posters. Every candidate and every team member is measured against them.

The long game

 This is not a stepping stone. We are looking for someone who wants a home, a place that could be the last job you ever take, decades from now. We invest in people who invest in us.

Requirements

Full-time US Central hours, long term

You use Claude or ChatGPT daily as a thinking partner, to pressure-test ideas, sharpen your writing and learn faster. Not to copy answers you do not understand. We want people who get smarter with it, not lazier.

Strong in Google Workspace

Reliable internet, backup power and a quiet workspace

Experience supporting a CEO or founder is a plus. Intelligence and judgment matter more.

This is not for you if you want a short-term job, a resume builder, or a role with fixed routines and detailed instructions for every task.

How to apply

 Send your resume.

What happens next

Online skills assessments 
 skills, attention to detail, executive assistant skills)

Personality profile. We hire for a specific profile, and it is a hard requirement.

Culture conversation with our COO

Interview with the CEO

Reference calls with people you reported to directly

title: Creative Strategist - DTC and Meta Paid Social
description:
About the Role

This is a strategy-first role. You will own the creative thinking for two to three DTC accounts — the desires we go after, the avatars we speak to, the angles we test, the concepts that carry them, and the briefs that get them made.

You do not edit video, design statics, or buy media. You will occasionally build reference frames so an editor can see what you mean, but execution is not your job. D
 what gets made, and why, is.

Most of the work sits in health, wellness, and supplements, with room to expand into other e-commerce categories. It is a crowded, compliance-tight space where the gap between a winning ad and a dead one is almost always the angle, not the production quality.



Work Structure & Requirements

Schedule: Central European Time

Compensation: 8 USD per hour **negotiable



Key Responsibilities

1. Creative Strategy

Start from the desire the product actually serves, not the feature list

Identify the core avatar and sub-avatars underneath it, defined by what they have already tried and why it failed them

Turn those into testable angles, then into concepts, then into briefs — three different things, and you brief all three

Maintain a pipeline across angles, formats, hooks, and offers, with a stated reason for every test

Balance net-new concepts against iterations of proven winners

2. Brief Writing

Produce 5–15 briefs per client per week depending on scope, across short-form video, UGC, statics, and native-style formats

Every brief ships ready to execute: hook and opening concept, core message, script or talking points, visual direction, CTA, required assets, and editing notes

Write scripts yourself — an editor should never have to come back and ask what you meant

3. Research

Mine Amazon reviews (positive and negative) for the words customers actually use

Use Google searches to find what the market is confused about

Analyze Meta Ad Library and other ad libraries — what competitors are running, how long it has been live, and the technique underneath it rather than the line itself

Review competitor sites, offers, pricing, and landing pages

Pull voice of customer from Reddit, YouTube comments, ad comments, support tickets, and forums — their own sentence reads as recognition; a paraphrased problem reads as marketing

Identify what the market has already been told and already tried, so you stop repeating a claim it stopped believing

4. Performance Review & Recommendations

Come to performance reviews having already asked for the data you need — chasing the right numbers is part of the role

Diagnose why something won or lost specifically: was it the angle or the execution?

Recommend what to kill, what to iterate, and what to leave running — with the reasoning behind each call

Feed learnings directly into the next round of briefs

5. AI Integration

Use AI as part of your workflow for research, synthesis, ideation support, reference frames, and speeding up mechanical parts of the job

Hooks, angles, and scripts come from you — not AI



Required Skills & Experience

Experience: 3+ years personally owning creative strategy for DTC paid social — in-house or agency; owning it, not contributing to it

Performance Mindset: You judge creative on hook rate, hold rate, CTR, and CPA/ROAS against a target — not on whether it looks good

title: Public Relations Specialist
description:
Company Description Strauss 



Communications is a boutique agency that partners with technology companies to shape and elevate their storytelling. The team is composed of media industry veterans who understand how to craft narratives for maximum impact. The agency focuses on media visibility, flagship content, social engagement, and other channels to help clients reach their audiences effectively. Strauss Communications offers a collaborative environment where communication professionals can work closely with innovative tech brands and develop strategic, high-profile campaigns.



Role Description 



The Public Relations Specialist is a full-time, remote role responsible for developing and executing PR strategies for technology clients. Day-to-day work includes drafting press releases, creating pitch materials, maintaining media lists, and coordinating outreach to journalists and influencers. The specialist will manage media relations, respond to inquiries, and secure coverage across relevant outlets. Additional responsibilities include supporting strategic communications plans, monitoring industry trends, preparing briefing documents, and collaborating with internal and client teams to ensure consistent messaging. The role requires proactive communication, strong writing skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines in a virtual environment.



Qualifications

 

-Strong Public Relations and Media Relations skills, including experience securing coverage and managing press interactions.

-Expertise in strategic communications, with the ability to craft clear, compelling narratives and campaign messaging.

-Excellent Communication skills, including concise writing, professional client communication, and confident presentation abilities.

-Candidates should possess the ability to plan and execute PR campaigns, manage multiple client priorities, and work effectively in a remote, deadline-driven setting.

-Relevant qualifications include prior experience in an agency or in-house PR role, familiarity with the technology sector, and proficiency with media monitoring and PR tools.

-A bachelor’s degree in Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, Marketing, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, is beneficial.

title: Experienced creative editor for Instagram/TikTok/YouTube
description:
Hi I'm Lauri - a content creator with an audience in Germany, and I'm now building my English-speaking audience in the US from the ground up. I'm looking for one creative person who wants to build this with me.



What the job looks like:

I film everything. My footage folder already has lots of material, much of it long, raw, unedited video and new footage is added everyday. Your job is to go through it, find the gold and cut it out. That takes patience and especially a good eye for social media, because the best 20 seconds are often hidden in a 40-minute clip. There will also be specific projects, where i provide you with footage and the idea and you make it happen. 



From that you will make:

- Reels, TikToks and YouTube Shorts

- Longer YouTube vlogs

- Trend formats

- Occasional carousel posts (photos + text)



This is not a "cut exactly what I tell you" job. Your creativity is an important part of the work. I will give you general directions, as well as detailed feedback and tips. However, you pick the moments, you find the hooks and you bring ideas.



How we work together:

I'm looking for someone reliable who works closely with me but can also work on their own. You only edit, so your job is to choose well: pick the moments and angles where I look my best and leave out the rest. I often say or do something three or four times in a row. You have to be able to identify the best take and use that one.

It's very important that your edits match my style. The viewers should ideally not be able to tell that the video wasn't cut by me, so you will have to learn about and adapt to what me and my audience likes.

However, I'm very open, and your own creativity is more than welcome. Incorporating your own style and ideas is a big part of this job, you just have to find a way to match my style.

What matters to me is that you can take honest feedback and critique well and use it to get better.



You:

- Have a sense of humor and know how to edit for it: timing, cuts, zooms, sound effects, text. My content should be fun to watch

- Have a good eye when selecting footage: you choose the most flattering moments and the best take

- Can spot the funny, surprising or relatable moment in long raw footage

- Edit short-form and long-form

- Can build carousels (Canva is fine)

- Know what works for a US audience: trends, sounds, hooks and pacing

- Work independently without daily instructions

- Write good English, so captions and on-screen text are error-free

- are familiar with women's social media: My audience is primarily female and my content is tailored to their taste. You need to understand the audience and their preferences. Having a channel of your own or actively consuming content in my niche is a big plus. 



What you get:

- A long-term role with one creator, not one-off gigs

- Room to grow: we start with about 12 hours a week, and this can increase quickly if it goes well. Your pay and responsibility grow with it

- creative freedom: as i mentioned, autonomy and creativity are essential



About my content: I make travel and lifestyle content, with daily vlogs, some beauty and make-up, and a bit of fashion now and then. I travel all the time, so the footage is varied: new places, everyday moments, getting ready, trying things out. No two weeks look the same.



Details:

- About 12 hours/week to start, flexible schedule (if we work well together, we can increase hours and pay)

- Starting at $5/hour, about $260/month

- English content

- Time tracked with TimeProof

- Paid test task before hiring



Don't apply if:

- You do video editing, but for brands or other types of content. I am specifically looking for someone who has experience working with creators, not companies. 

- You don't use social media. It's essential to have a good understanding of online trends, language and etiquette.



To apply:

Send your best short-form or long-form videos that you edited yourself. Please don't include AI videos, only manually edited footage.



Can't wait to see what you create. Lauri

About the Role

title: Quality Assurance, Quality Control & Safety Analyst (QAQC)
description:
The TAMAKA Group, LLC | Remote 



Schedule: Monday–Friday, 7:00 AM–1:00 PM U.S. Central Time (30 hours weekly)

Reports To: Chief Operating Officer (COO)

Growth Opportunity: Full-Time Employment and Future QAQC/Safety Department Leadership



Position Overview



The TAMAKA Group seeks an experienced QAQC & Safety Analyst to provide independent oversight of quality assurance, safety compliance, project documentation, and continuous improvement across U.S. water and wastewater infrastructure operations.



This position reports directly to the COO and works collaboratively with Project Management and field Operations while maintaining independent oversight responsibilities.



The successful candidate will help develop and strengthen TAMAKA’s QAQC and Safety function, with the potential to build and lead a dedicated team as the company expands.



Key Responsibilities



1. Quality Assurance & Quality Control



Independently review work orders, field reports, photographs, and project documentation for accuracy, completeness, and compliance.

Identify quality deficiencies, discrepancies, recurring problems, and opportunities for improvement.

Maintain QAQC scorecards, audit records, corrective-action logs, and performance reporting.

Verify documented resolution of deficiencies and escalate unresolved findings.

2. Safety Compliance & JSA Development



Independently develop, generate, review, and maintain task-specific Job Safety Analyses (JSAs) and Job Hazard Analyses (JHAs).

Identify work steps, associated hazards, risk levels, and appropriate control measures.

Review daily JSAs and field documentation for completeness and alignment with work activities.

Monitor field photographs and WhatsApp reporting for observable safety deficiencies.

Review documentation involving PPE, excavation, trench safety, confined spaces, equipment operations, and other relevant construction hazards.

Coordinate with field supervisors regarding site-specific hazards and required corrective actions.

Escalate significant safety concerns immediately to authorized field leadership and the COO.

3. Weekly Safety Training & Employee Development



Develop, coordinate, and deliver weekly safety training meetings for field personnel and relevant company employees.

Research and select training topics appropriate to active projects, seasonal conditions, identified hazards, and company safety performance.

Create original training materials, including presentations, toolbox talks, safety bulletins, instructional documents, and supporting visual resources.

Maintain a structured weekly safety training calendar.

Document training sessions, including topics covered, dates, instructors, and employee participation.

Track attendance and maintain individual employee safety training records.

Identify missed training sessions and coordinate make-up training.

Evaluate training effectiveness through participation, field observations, assessment results, and recurring safety deficiencies.

Recommend improvements to training content and delivery based on findings and operational needs.

Ensure training documentation is organized and available for internal audits, client reviews, and compliance verification.

4. Employee Onboarding & Training Program Improvement



Review, evaluate, and continuously update existing employee onboarding and safety orientation materials.

Develop standardized safety onboarding checklists, training modules, and competency assessments.

Ensure onboarding materials reflect current company procedures, applicable safety requirements, and relevant operational risks.

Coordinate with Operations and designated administrative personnel to ensure new employees receive required safety orientation.

Track completion of onboarding training and maintain accurate employee training records.

Identify gaps in onboarding content, employee understanding, and training effectiveness.

Apply continuous process improvement principles to strengthen onboarding consistency, efficiency, and compliance.

Maintain document version control and periodic review schedules for onboarding and safety training materials.

5. Documentation & Compliance Management



Maintain organized, auditable quality and safety documentation.

Manage training records, certification registers, inspection reports, compliance documentation, and corrective-action records.

Review project communications and daily reporting for missing or inconsistent information.

Support internal audits, project closeout, and compliance reporting.

6. Formal Project Management Processes



Apply structured project management principles to quality and safety oversight.

Understand project scope, deliverables, milestones, risk registers, issue tracking, change control, and reporting requirements.

Collaborate with Project Managers while maintaining independent QAQC and Safety responsibilities.

Produce weekly performance summaries and recommend corrective or preventive actions.

7. Team Development & Leadership



Assist in establishing and improving the QAQC and Safety department.

Develop departmental procedures, reporting standards, training resources, and performance metrics.

Demonstrate the ability and willingness to recruit, mentor, and eventually supervise additional QAQC and Safety personnel.

Maintain collaborative relationships with Project Management and Operations without compromising independent oversight.

Required Qualifications



Minimum 3 years of relevant construction QAQC, occupational safety, or infrastructure compliance experience.

Demonstrated experience developing and reviewing JSAs/JHAs.

Experience preparing and delivering safety training, toolbox talks, or employee safety orientations.

Experience developing training materials and maintaining attendance and training-completion records.

Experience reviewing, updating, and improving employee onboarding or safety training programs.

Strong knowledge of hazard identification, risk assessment, safety documentation, and corrective-action management.

Experience with formal project management processes.

Fluent written and spoken English is mandatory.

Strong organizational, analytical, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.

Proven ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team.

Willingness and ability to support the development of a growing QAQC and Safety department.

Safety Training & Certifications



OSHA 30-Hour Construction Outreach Training preferred, with completion expected within 90 days where accessible and appropriate.

Equivalent recognized occupational safety qualifications considered.

ISO 9001 and ISO 45001 knowledge preferred.

PMP or CAPM certification is a plus.

Six Sigma Yellow Belt or Green Belt certification is a plus.

Company Culture & Professional Expectations



Candidates must demonstrate alignment with TAMAKA’s core values:



Safety. Quality. Transparency. Accountability.



We seek a dependable, proactive team player who communicates clearly, accepts responsibility, provides constructive feedback, and approaches problems with a continuous improvement mindset.



The successful candidate must be comfortable working in a growing organization, developing new processes, and collaborating across departments.



Schedule & Reporting



Remote, Monday–Friday, 7:00 AM–1:00 PM U.S. Central Time.

Initial commitment of 30 hours weekly, with potential for full-time advancement.

Reports directly to the COO.

Operates independently from Project Management and field Operations.

Significant or unresolved safety and quality concerns may be escalated to the CEO.

Future opportunity to build and lead a dedicated QAQC and Safety team.

Application Requirements



Applicants must submit:



Current résumé in English.

Relevant safety, QAQC, and project management training or certifications.

Two examples of JSAs/JHAs personally developed, with confidential information removed.

An example of safety training material or a toolbox talk personally developed.

Description of experience managing employee training records and improving onboarding procedures.

Summary of formal project management experience.

Expected hourly compensation in USD and confirmation of schedule availability.

Shortlisted candidates will complete a practical assessment involving JSA development, quality and safety documentation review, and preparation of a short safety training presentation.

- Working knowledge of cXML and JSON, and of at least two of SAP Ariba, Coupa, Workday, Oracle, Jaggaer and SAP.

title: Crypto BD Lead: $100 Per Qualified Call + Uncapped Partnership Revenue (Player-Coach)
description:
Part-time: 20 hrs/week | $10/hr base + $100 per appointment you book + overrides and deal bonuses, no cap | Remote | Crypto/DeFi



At target pace this role pays roughly $1,500 to $2,500/month from base and appointment bonuses alone, before any partnership revenue, with no cap on the upside. Base is the floor, not the offer.



𝗔𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗚𝗠𝗜



GonnaMakeIt (GMI) built LP Bonds, a live DeFi liquidity product deployed across 9+ EVM chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, and more).



LP Bonds lock liquidity for 20 years while giving users a tradeable Bond NFT earning
% APR. The liquidity is locked, the user is not: they can sell their Bond NFT anytime. Rewards accrue inside the bond instead of being farmed and dumped.



Our partnership targets: DEXs, token launchpads, L1/L2 blockchain ecosystems, and select token projects with strong strategic fit.



We need someone to build and run a BD engine that consistently puts qualified partnership calls on the founder's calendar.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗿𝗼𝗹𝗲



One job: produce qualified partnership calls that actually happen, every week.



The founder takes the calls and closes. You own everything before that: rep recruiting and management, target selection, qualification, outreach strategy, follow-up, pipeline, booking, call prep, and funnel diagnosis.



This is a player-coach role. You manage commission-based BD reps AND personally do outreach and book calls whenever the team is below target. Meetings, training, recruiting, and spreadsheet work do not count as output. Qualified calls held count as output.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗺𝗲𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗰



Qualified partnership appointments held per week. After ramp: floor 2 personally booked, target 5 team total, strong 6+.



A call counts only when ALL are true: the target passes our qualification standard, the attendee is a decision-maker (or credible sponsor with direct access to one), they explicitly expressed interest in LP Bonds for their org, they know what the call is about, the call happens, a real partnership discussion occurs, and the founder confirms it was qualified.



Does NOT count: no-shows, reschedules until held, calls where they pitch their product to us, generic networking, community mods who can't advance a deal, duplicates, or projects that can't realistically use LP Bonds.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝗼𝘄𝗻



1. Rep performance. Audit the existing rep team immediately. Recruit replacements as needed. Give each rep target accounts, messaging, channels, and weekly numbers. Coach producers, cut non-producers. A rep showing no meaningful pipeline progress after 10 working days gets diagnosed and acted on, not carried for 30.

2. Targeting. At least 80% of the active pipeline is DEXs, launchpads, and L1/L2 ecosystems. Targets are EVM-compatible unless the founder approves an exception. Do not fill the pipeline with projects just because they're easy to reach.

3. Qualification. You run (or audit) our LP Bonds Partner Assessment on every interested project. Score of 5/10+ on our Reach/Health/Access rubric passes to the founder. Before any prospect reaches the founder you confirm: real scale/traction, a genuine LP Bonds fit, a decision-maker in the loop, and explicit interest in LP Bonds for THEM. "We want to explore this for our ecosystem" is interest. "Sounds cool, let's find synergies" is not.

4. Conversion, not volume. Our history shows the exact failure you're hired to prevent: reps sending 40-60 outreaches a week, reporting "interested projects," and producing no decision-maker conversations and no calls. You own the conversion at every stage:



Positive reply → meaningful advancement within 5 business days. That means a decision-maker conversation, a
 group or direct thread with the right person, or a concrete scheduled next step toward a call. If none occurs, the prospect is recycled or closed out of active pipeline. Claimed interest that never advances counts as nothing.



Any opportunity untouched for 5 business days gets a decision: advance, recycle, or close. Nothing sits in "waiting."



"Calendly shared" is not a completed task. No booking within 2 business days means follow-up happens, and the prospect is told to confirm the booking with both you and the rep.



If significant outreach produces no qualified calls, you identify the failure point (targets, contacts, messaging, channel, follow-up, or rep) and launch a new test within 24 hours. The same broken approach never runs for multiple weeks.



5. Pipeline control. One accurate source of truth: target, category, tier, contact and decision-maker status, owner, every touch, stage, next action, deadline, call status. Duplicate outreach prevented. All partner groups remain accessible to GMI even if a rep leaves. All activity is logged in our tracker same day. Unlogged work doesn't exist and doesn't pay.

6. Founder handoff. Before a call goes on the founder's calendar: a short brief covering who they are, why they're qualified, why LP Bonds fit, what interest they expressed, who d
, and the desired outcome. No Calendly shared before the qualification gate is complete.

7. Reporting and escalation. Every Friday YOU post one consolidated report: outreach sent, positive replies, qualified conversations, groups created, calls booked, calls held, conversion at each stage, per-rep results, stalled deals, next week's tests. Exact numbers and names, no narratives. Chasing reps for their numbers is your job, done before Friday, never visible to the founder.



If the week is heading to zero qualified calls, you tell the founder THAT DAY with the likely cause, the numbers, the fix being launched, and when results should show.



Bad news early is rewarded. Bad news buried is a dealbreaker.



𝗧𝗶𝗺𝗲 𝗮𝗹𝗹𝗼𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻



50%+ on outreach, follow-up, and appointment conversion

Up to 25% managing and recruiting reps

Up to 25% research, reporting, and admin



Building internal tools, assigning books, refining meeting formats, and polishing trackers do not count toward anything. If the team is below target, your personal outreach time goes up.



𝗙𝗶𝗿𝘀𝘁 𝟯𝟬 𝗱𝗮𝘆𝘀 (𝗽𝗮𝗶𝗱 𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗮𝗹)



Week 1: full audit of every rep and the current pipeline, clean pipeline and reporting live, personal outreach started.

Day 14: 2+ qualified appointments held. Zero held by Day 14 triggers an immediate role review.

Day 30: 2+ qualified appointments held per week pace, clean pipeline, producing rep core. Target: 3+/week.



Hit the numbers and this grows into a larger BD leadership role with more hours and higher comp as we scale.



𝗖𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗲𝗻𝘀𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻



Base: $10/hr, up to 20 hrs/week



Minimum Requirement: 2 qualified appointments held per week that you personally booked. Your base pay covers these first two. Every additional personally booked appointment pays $100, and every rep-booked appointment pays you the $30 override, starting from the first. The 30-day trial milestones above set the ramp: 2+ held by Day 14, 2+/week pace by Day 30.



$100 for every qualified appointment held that you personally booked beyond your weekly minimum of 2

$30 override for every qualified appointment held that your reps booked



𝗣𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽 𝗿𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗻𝘂𝗲, 𝘁𝘄𝗼 𝗹𝗮𝗻𝗲𝘀:



Partnerships YOU originated: you earn the full rep package.



- Commission: 20% of all upgrade fees generated by the partnership during its first 180 days live.

- Launch Bonus: 3% of the total dollar value of bonds minted through the partnership during its first 180 days live.

- No ceiling on either.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘁𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗹𝗼𝗼𝗸𝘀 𝗹𝗶𝗸𝗲 𝗼𝗻 𝗼𝗻𝗲 𝗽𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽:



- Mints $100,000 and generates $15,000 in upgrade fees: $3,000 + $3,000 = $6,000

- Mints $200,000 and generates $30,000 in upgrade fees: $6,000 + $6,000 = $12,000



Partnerships your REPS originated: you earn a 20% override on everything the rep earns from that partnership, both their 20% commission on upgrade fees and their 3% launch bonus, for the same 180-day window. Paid by GMI on top of their earnings, never deducted from them.



Every partnership has exactly one originator of record in our tracker, so lanes never stack on the same deal.



Additional bonuses possible for exceptional strategic partnerships.



No cap on any of the above. One appointment bonus per call ($100 personal OR $30 override, not both).



Appointment bonuses paid after the call happens and the founder confirms it met the standard.



Base and appointment bonuses paid 50/50 in ETH and $GMI, with the GMI portion on an 18-month vesting schedule. Commission are paid bi-weekly as your 20% share of the $GMI collected in upgrade fees (fully liquid, no vesting), so your cut never depends on GMI price. Launch bonus is 3% of the USD value of bonds at time of mint, paid bi-weekly in ETH at the average ETH price over the 14 day payroll period.



𝗥𝗲𝗾𝘂𝗶𝗿𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘀



- Crypto-native: DEXs, launchpads, liquidity, TVL, ecosystems, no googling required

- Prior crypto BD, partnerships, lead-gen, or appointment-setting experience with calls you personally booked

- Experience managing contractors or reps against numbers, and comfortable cutting non-performers

- Excellent written English, comfortable messaging founders and senior decision-makers

- Organized: CRMs, trackers,
, X, LinkedIn,
, outreach platforms (we use Saleshandy)

- 3+ hrs daily overlap with GMT+7/+8

- Responsive within 10 minutes during your agreed working block unless on a scheduled call



𝗪𝗼𝗿𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘀𝘁𝗮𝗻𝗱𝗮𝗿𝗱𝘀



Outcomes over activity. Calls held over calls promised. Decision-makers over moderators. Explicit interest over vague networking. Exact numbers over narratives. Problems escalated the day they appear. No hiding bad weeks. No perfecting systems that don't produce calls. The founder never manages your reps.



𝗛𝗼𝘄 𝘁𝗼 𝗮𝗽𝗽𝗹𝘆



Applications missing any item are auto-rejected. Send:



1. IMPORTANT: Your subject line must start with BOND OPS .

2. Loom video (2-3 min): who you are, your crypto experience, the most qualified appointments you've personally booked in one month, and how you'd produce 5 qualified GMI partnership calls per week.

5. One target for GMI (a DEX, launchpad, or ecosystem): why it's qualified, the exact role you'd contact, the channel, and the personalized first message you'd send.

6. Your
 handle, available hours in GMT+8, and earliest start date.

title: Pet Portrait Editor
description:
We are offering a new position - editing pet portraits. The daily quota is 50 edits (editing 50 portraits a day, Tuesday to Friday.) For a monthly salary of £400. 

This can be done at any time of the day, to fit around existing commitments. However, each day - the 50 edits assigned to you must be completed within 24 hours. 



The edits are extremely varied. But a recent analysis has found around 70% of customers asking for just 1 small revision. less than 5% of customers require extensive repetitive edits. So, this is quite a fast paced job - 70% of the time! In house, we can expect to edit around 10-12 edits per hour. Just to give you an idea of the time commitment involved with this position. 



The ideal candidate will have experience with vector style pet portrait images. To understand how to effectively and accurately illustrate customers' pets and really bring their personality to life. 



The types of edit requests we receive can vary greatly. However, they are around 70% of the time extremely quick, simple and repetitive jobs. We are an embroidery company who illustrates customers' pets portraits, before embroidering them on a number of items. Due to embroidery limitations, the portraits produced cannot be too detailed, cannot use a blend of colours or gradients and details cannot be too fine. Which makes for quite simple editing, due to the fact we cannot include too many details. 



Each candidate must have great English, able to read and understand customers requests. As well as a good level of artistic ability. 



We do offer a trial of 5 edits, to give you an idea of the type of things you will encounter whilst editing our customers portraits. This is also so we can assess your ability. 



This is a temporary contract till the end of December. After this time, if sales are still large enough - we are looking to continue the contract further. 





The ideal candidate would: 

Ability to read and understand customers' requests fully and accurately. 

Have experience with embroidery ready designs or an understanding of working in limitations in order to create effective embroidery artworks. 

Effectively identifying the need for further escalation with difficult customers and problem orders & communicating this with management. 

Ability to follow instructions fully - ensuring protocols are always adhered to. 

Understanding the requirements of embroidery ready artwork and translating customers requests to fit within these limitations. 

Maintaining a friendly and professional attitude when sending customers their edited artwork. 

Making sure no edits are sent without customers' questions being answered.

title: Online English/World History Teachers (Near-Native Accent)
description:
About Pomelo Academy

Pomelo Academy is an innovative online international school dedicated to delivering high-quality education to students worldwide. We provide a dynamic and engaging learning environment, catering to individualized instruction that transcends geographical boundaries.



Job Description

We are seeking passionate and experienced Near-Native English-speaking Online K-12 Math and/or Science Teachers with verifiable teaching certifications. The ideal candidates will have strong academic backgrounds in Mathematics and/or Science, experience teaching young learners (ages 5–18), and a commitment to creating a supportive, inquiry-based, and engaging online learning environment.



Responsibilities



Deliver interactive and engaging Math and/or Science lessons to individuals and small groups of 2–6 students aged 5–18.

Teach using internationally recognized curricula such as A Closer Look, Glencoe Science, Pearson Interactive Science, NGSS-aligned resources, Singapore Math, or IB/AP/A Level Math programs.

Create age-appropriate lesson plans focused on conceptual understanding, inquiry, problem-solving, and real-world applications.

Incorporate visuals, multimedia, and hands-on virtual activities to make abstract concepts accessible and engaging.

Monitor student progress and provide timely feedback to students and parents.

Foster curiosity, discussion, and active learning in a safe and supportive space.
