title: Social Media Video Editor & Marketing Assistant
description:
Company: WebLift Digital

Job Type: Part-Time | Remote

Working Hours: 20 hours per week (4 hours per day, Monday–Friday)

Location: Philippines (Work From Home)

Salary: Competitive, based on skills and experience

Opportunity: Long-term position with potential for career growth



About WebLift Digital

WebLift Digital is a growing digital marketing agency dedicated to helping businesses build a strong, authentic, and results-driven online presence.



We combine creativity, innovation, and practical marketing strategies to help brands connect with their audiences, attract new customers, and achieve sustainable growth.



We work closely with our clients to understand their goals, develop tailored digital solutions, and continuously identify new opportunities to grow their businesses.



As our team and client portfolio expand, we're looking for a creative, resourceful, and highly organized individual who can grow alongside us.



About the Role

We're looking for a Social Media Video Editor & Marketing Assistant who can create engaging, high-quality short-form videos quickly while supporting our Social Media Manager with day-to-day marketing operations.



This is not just a video editing position. We want someone who understands social media, keeps up with emerging trends, brings fresh ideas to the table, and can confidently assist with various social media management tasks.



Speed and efficiency are extremely important to us. We need someone who can turn raw footage into engaging, polished Instagram and
 Reels within the same working day for standard edits, without compromising quality.



You should be comfortable working in a fast-paced agency environment, managing priorities, and taking initiative rather than waiting for instructions every step of the way.



If you love creating Reels, understand what makes people stop scrolling, and enjoy working behind the scenes to keep social media operations running smoothly, we'd love to hear from you!



Key Responsibilities

1. Video Editing & Reel Production (Primary Responsibility)

-Edit engaging, professional short-form videos for Instagram Reels,
 Reels, and other social media platforms as needed.

-Deliver standard Reel edits within the same working day, depending on the complexity and availability of materials.

-Transform raw footage into polished, attention-grabbing content.

-Add engaging hooks, captions, transitions, sound effects, music, and other relevant visual elements.

-Understand pacing, storytelling, and audience retention techniques.

-Repurpose existing video footage into multiple short-form content pieces.

-Follow brand guidelines and maintain consistency across different client accounts.

-Make revisions promptly based on feedback.

-Organize and maintain video assets and completed content files.



2. Social Media Trends & Content Research

-Stay updated on Instagram and
 trends, viral content formats, trending audio, and creative editing styles.

-Conduct regular competitor research and identify content opportunities for our clients.

-Recommend fresh Reel ideas, hooks, and content angles.

-Help the Social Media Manager identify emerging trends relevant to different industries.

-Contribute creative ideas during content planning and brainstorming sessions.

-Understand that trends should be adapted to each brand rather than copied blindly.



3. Social Media Management Support

-Assist the Social Media Manager with day-to-day tasks across multiple client accounts.

-Help prepare, organize, and schedule social media content when required.

-Assist with captions, hashtags, and basic content optimization.

-Support content calendar management and maintain organized workflows.

-Assist with content updates, revisions, and client feedback.

-Help ensure social media deliverables are completed accurately and on schedule.

-Provide general administrative support related to social media operations.



4. Analytics, Reporting & Administrative Support

-Assist in tracking weekly and monthly social media performance.

-Gather analytics from Meta Business Suite and other relevant platforms.

-Update performance trackers, spreadsheets, and reporting documents.

-Monitor basic metrics such as reach, engagement, views, follower growth, and content performance.

-Help identify top-performing content and opportunities for improvement.

-Maintain organized records of content production, publishing, and performance.



What We're Looking For

-Required Skills & Qualifications

-Proven experience editing short-form videos for Instagram Reels,
 Reels, or TikTok.

-Proficiency in video editing software such as CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, or similar tools.

-Ability to produce quality video edits quickly, with minimal supervision.

-Strong understanding of social media trends, video hooks, pacing, and audience engagement.

-Familiarity with Instagram and
 content formats and best practices.

-Basic knowledge of social media management and content scheduling.

-Comfortable working with Google Sheets, Google Drive, and other productivity tools.

-Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.

-Good written and spoken English communication skills.

-Reliable internet connection and a computer capable of video editing.

-Ability to manage deadlines and communicate progress proactively.

-Bonus Skills (Not Required, but a Plus)

-Experience using Meta Business Suite.

-Experience creating social media graphics in Canva.

-Familiarity with Asana, Trello, or other project management tools.

-Experience preparing social media analytics reports.

-Basic knowledge of social media advertising and paid content.

-Experience working with multiple brands or a digital marketing agency.

-Understanding of content marketing, branding, and social media growth strategies.

-The Ideal Candidate



We're looking for someone who is:

-Fast and efficient: You can deliver standard Reel edits within the same working day.

-Creative: You bring fresh ideas and understand what makes content engaging.

-Trend-aware: You actively follow social media trends and know how to adapt them to different brands.

-Proactive: You identify opportunities and take initiative without constant supervision.

-Organized: You can manage multiple tasks, deadlines, and client requirements.

-Detail-oriented: You care about clean edits, accurate captions, and consistent branding.

-Reliable: You communicate clearly, meet deadlines, and take ownership of your work.

-Adaptable: You're willing to learn new tools, take feedback, and support the team wherever needed.



What We Offer

-100% remote, work-from-home opportunity.

-Part-time schedule of approximately 20 hours per week.

-Long-term opportunity with a growing digital marketing agency.

-Potential to transition into a full-time role as the company expands.

-Opportunities to develop your skills in video editing, social media marketing, and digital strategy.

-Exposure to multiple brands, industries, and creative projects.

-A collaborative and supportive working environment.

-Opportunities to take on greater responsibilities as you grow with the company.



How to Apply

-If you're interested, please submit the following:

-Your updated resume or CV.

-Your portfolio: Links to at least 3–5 short-form videos or Reels you've personally edited.

-Your editing tools: Tell us which video editing software you use most frequently.

-Your turnaround time: How long does it typically take you to edit a 30–60-second Reel from raw footage?

-Your experience: Briefly describe your experience with social media management, trend research, or analytics reporting.

-Your expected monthly salary in PHP for a 20-hour-per-week position.

-Your availability: Let us know when you can start.



To help us identify applicants who have carefully read the job description, please begin your application with: "READY TO CREATE."



We're excited to find someone who is passionate about social media, takes pride in their work, and wants to grow with WebLift Digital.



Apply today and let's create something great together!
